title.zh: 卷十六 志第六 禮三
title.raw: 卷十六 志第六 禮三 Volume 16 Treatises 6: Rituals 3

meta.sourceNote: ChineseNotes scrape had source glyph artifacts; chapter body imported from Wikisource after ChineseNotes glossary scrape.

sentences.zh: 「國之大事，在祀與戎」。

translations.literal: "The great affairs of a state lie in sacrifice and war."
translations.idiomatic: "The great affairs of a state are sacrifice and war."

sentences.zh: 自書契經典，咸崇其義，而聖人之德，莫大於嚴父者也。

translations.literal: From the age of written contracts and canonical texts, all have revered this principle, and among the virtues of the sage, none is greater than honoring one's father.
translations.idiomatic: Ever since the age of written records and canonical scripture, all have honored this principle; among a sage's virtues, none surpasses reverence for one's father.

sentences.zh: 故司馬遷著封禪書，班固備郊祀志，上紀皇王正祀，下錄郡國百神。

translations.literal: Therefore Sima Qian wrote the Treatise on the Feng and Shan Sacrifices, and Ban Gu fully set forth the Treatise on Suburban Sacrifices, recording above the proper sacrifices of emperors and kings and below the hundred spirits of the commanderies and kingdoms.
translations.idiomatic: Hence Sima Qian composed the Treatise on the Feng and Shan Sacrifices, while Ban Gu compiled the Treatise on Suburban Sacrifices, chronicling above the orthodox rites of emperors and kings and below the myriad deities worshipped in the commanderies and kingdoms.

sentences.zh: 司馬彪又著祭祀志以續終漢。

translations.literal: Sima Biao also wrote a Treatise on Sacrificial Rites to continue the record of Later Han.
translations.idiomatic: Sima Biao likewise wrote a Treatise on Sacrificial Rites to carry on the history of the Later Han.

sentences.zh: 中興以後，其舊制誕章，粲然弘備。

translations.literal: After the Restoration, the former regulations became splendidly comprehensive.
translations.idiomatic: After the dynasty's restoration, the old institutions grew brilliantly complete in their provisions.

sentences.zh: 自茲以降，又有異同。

translations.literal: From this point onward, there were also variations and agreements.
translations.idiomatic: From that time forward, there were further points of difference and agreement as well.

sentences.zh: 故復撰次云爾。

translations.literal: Therefore I compile and arrange the record as follows.
translations.idiomatic: Hence the present compilation and arrangement.

sentences.zh: 漢獻帝延康元年十一月己丑，詔公卿告祠高廟。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the day jichou, of the first year of Yankang of Emperor Xian of Han, an edict ordered the dukes and ministers to announce sacrifices at the High Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On the jichou day of the eleventh month of the first year of Yankang under Emperor Xian of Han, an edict commanded the nobles and ministers to announce sacrifices at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 遣兼御史大夫張音奉皇帝璽綬策書，禪帝位于魏。

translations.literal: He dispatched Acting Grandee Secretary Zhang Yin to present the imperial seal-cord and the written abdication decree, abdicating the imperial position to Wei.
translations.idiomatic: He sent Acting Grandee Secretary Zhang Yin bearing the imperial seal and cord along with the written abdication decree, yielding the throne to Wei.

sentences.zh: 是時魏文帝繼王位，南巡在潁陰。

translations.literal: At this time King Wen of Wei had succeeded to the kingship and was making a southern tour, staying at Yingyin.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Cao Pi had already succeeded as King of Wei and was on a southern tour at Yingyin.

sentences.zh: 有司乃為壇於潁陰之繁陽故城。

translations.literal: The responsible officials then built an altar at the old city of Fanyang in Yingyin.
translations.idiomatic: The responsible officials then erected an altar at the old city of Fanyang in Yingyin.

sentences.zh: 庚午，登壇。

translations.literal: On the day gengwu, he ascended the altar.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengwu day, he ascended the altar.

sentences.zh: 魏相國華歆跪受璽紱以進於王。

translations.literal: Hua Xin, Chancellor of Wei, knelt to receive the seal-cord and presented it to the king.
translations.idiomatic: Hua Xin, Chancellor of Wei, knelt to receive the seal and cord and presented them to the king.

sentences.zh: 既受畢，降壇視燎，成禮而返。

translations.literal: When the reception was complete, he descended the altar to observe the burning, completed the rites, and returned.
translations.idiomatic: Once he had received them, he descended the altar to witness the burning of offerings, completed the ceremony, and returned.

sentences.zh: 未有祖配之事。

translations.literal: There was no accompanying sacrifice to the ancestors.
translations.idiomatic: No ancestral accompaniment was performed.

sentences.zh: 魏文帝黃初二年正月，郊祀天地明堂。

translations.literal: In the first month of the second year of Huangchu of Emperor Wen of Wei, he performed suburban sacrifices to Heaven and Earth and at the Bright Hall.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the second year of Huangchu, Emperor Wen of Wei sacrificed to Heaven and Earth at the suburbs and at the Bright Hall.

sentences.zh: 是時魏都洛京，而神祇兆域明堂靈臺，皆因漢舊事。

translations.literal: At this time Wei had its capital at Luoyang, while the spirit domains, the Bright Hall, and the Spirit Terrace all followed Han precedents.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Wei had its capital at Luoyang, and the spirit domains, the Bright Hall, and the Spirit Terrace all followed Han precedents.

sentences.zh: 四年七月，帝將東巡，以大軍當出，使太常以一特牛告祠南郊，自後以為常。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the fourth year, as the emperor was about to tour east and the great army was to set out, he had the Minister of Ceremonies offer a single black bull to announce sacrifice at the southern suburb; thereafter this became regular practice.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the fourth year, as the emperor prepared to tour the east and the main army was about to march out, he had the Minister of Ceremonies offer a single black bull to announce sacrifice at the southern suburb; this thereafter became standard practice.

sentences.zh: 及文帝崩，太尉鍾繇告諡南郊，皆是有事於郊也。

translations.literal: When Emperor Wen died, Grand Commandant Zhong Yao announced the posthumous title at the southern suburb—all were matters involving the suburban sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Wen died, Grand Commandant Zhong Yao announced his posthumous title at the southern suburb—all were occasions involving suburban rites.

sentences.zh: 明帝太和元年正月丁未，郊祀武皇帝以配天，宗祀文皇帝於明堂以配上帝。

translations.literal: On the day dingwei of the first month of the first year of Taihe of Emperor Ming, he sacrificed at the suburbs to Emperor Wu as companion to Heaven, and performed ancestral sacrifice to Emperor Wen at the Bright Hall as companion to the Supreme Lord.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingwei day of the first month of the first year of Taihe, Emperor Ming sacrificed at the suburbs to Emperor Wu as Heaven's companion and performed ancestral sacrifice to Emperor Wen at the Bright Hall as companion to the Supreme Lord.

sentences.zh: 是時二漢郊禋之制具存，魏所損益可知也。

translations.literal: At this time the suburban sacrifice regulations of the two Han dynasties were fully preserved, and what Wei added or reduced can be known.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the suburban sacrifice institutions of the two Han dynasties were still fully preserved, so what Wei added or reduced can be clearly seen.

sentences.zh: 四年八月，帝東巡，過繁昌。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the fourth year, the emperor toured east and passed through Fanchang.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the fourth year, the emperor toured east and passed through Fanchang.

sentences.zh: 使執金吾臧霸行太尉事，以特牛祠受禪壇。

translations.literal: He had Bearer of the Gilded Mace Zang Ba act as Grand Commandant and offer a single black bull to sacrifice at the altar of abdication.
translations.idiomatic: He had Bearer of the Gilded Mace Zang Ba act as Grand Commandant and offer a single black bull in sacrifice at the altar where the throne had been yielded.

sentences.zh: 後漢紀，章帝詔高邑祠即位壇。

translations.literal: The Annals of Later Han record that Emperor Zhang issued an edict for Gaoyi to sacrifice at the altar of enthronement.
translations.idiomatic: The Annals of Later Han record that Emperor Zhang ordered Gaoyi to sacrifice at the altar of enthronement.

sentences.zh: 此雖前代已行之事，然為壇以祀天，而壇非神也。

translations.literal: Although this was a practice already carried out in former ages, one builds an altar to sacrifice to Heaven, yet the altar itself is not a spirit.
translations.idiomatic: Although this was a practice already carried out in former ages, an altar is built to sacrifice to Heaven, yet the altar itself is not a deity.

sentences.zh: 今無事於上帝，而致祀於虛壇，未詳所據也。

translations.literal: Now, when there is no service to the Supreme Lord, yet sacrifice is offered at an empty altar—the basis for this is unclear.
translations.idiomatic: Now, when there is no service to the Supreme Lord, yet sacrifice is offered at an empty altar—the basis for this is unclear.

sentences.zh: 景初元年十月乙卯，始營洛陽南委粟山為圓丘。

translations.literal: On the day yimao of the tenth month of the first year of Jingchu, construction began on Mount Weisu south of Luoyang as the Round Mound.
translations.idiomatic: On the yimao day of the tenth month of the first year of Jingchu, work began to build Mount Weisu south of Luoyang as the Round Mound Altar.

sentences.zh: 詔曰：「蓋帝王受命，莫不恭承天地，以彰神明；

translations.literal: An edict said: "When emperors and kings receive the Mandate, none fail reverently to receive Heaven and Earth, thereby manifesting the spirits and gods;
translations.idiomatic: An edict said: "When emperors and kings receive the Mandate, none fail reverently to receive Heaven and Earth, thereby manifesting the spirits and gods;

sentences.zh: 尊祀世統，以昭功德。

translations.literal: they honor and sacrifice to the dynastic line to display merit and virtue.
translations.idiomatic: they honor and sacrifice to the dynastic line to display merit and virtue.

sentences.zh: 故先代之典既著，則禘郊祖宗之制備也。

translations.literal: Therefore when the institutions of former ages are already established, the regulations for the di sacrifice, suburban sacrifice, and ancestral temple are complete.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore when the institutions of former ages are already established, the regulations for the di sacrifice, suburban sacrifice, and ancestral temple are complete.

sentences.zh: 昔漢氏之初，承秦滅學之後，採摭殘缺，以備郊祀。

translations.literal: In the beginning of the Han house, following upon Qin's destruction of learning, they gathered what remained in fragmentary form to complete the suburban sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: In the early days of the Han, following Qin's destruction of learning, they gathered what survived in fragmentary form to restore the suburban sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 自甘泉、后土、雍宮、五畤神祇兆位，多不經見，並以興廢無常，一彼一此，四百餘年，廢無禘禮。

translations.literal: From Ganquan, Houtu, Yong Palace, and the Five Altars, the spirit domains and shrine sites were mostly not seen in the classics, and because rise and fall were irregular, now one and now another—for more than four hundred years the di rite was abandoned.
translations.idiomatic: From Ganquan, Houtu, Yong Palace, and the Five Altars, the spirit domains and shrine sites were mostly absent from the classics, and because institutions rose and fell without fixed pattern, shifting from one to another—for more than four hundred years the di rite was abandoned.

sentences.zh: 古代之所更立者，遂有闕焉。

translations.literal: What the ancients had repeatedly established thus came to have gaps.
translations.idiomatic: What the ancients had repeatedly established thus came to have gaps.

sentences.zh: 曹氏世系，出自有虞氏，今祀圓丘，以始祖帝舜配，號圓丘曰皇皇帝天。

translations.literal: The Cao clan lineage derives from the Youyu clan; now at sacrifice at the Round Mound, the founding ancestor Emperor Shun is taken as companion, and the Round Mound is titled Imperial Imperial Emperor Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: The Cao clan lineage traces to the Youyu clan; at sacrifice at the Round Mound, the founding ancestor Emperor Shun serves as companion, and the Round Mound is titled Imperial Imperial Emperor Heaven.

sentences.zh: 方丘所祭曰皇皇后地，以舜妃伊氏配。

translations.literal: What is sacrificed at the Square Mound is titled Imperial Imperial Empress Earth, with Lady Yi, consort of Shun, as companion.
translations.idiomatic: What is sacrificed at the Square Mound is titled Imperial Imperial Empress Earth, with Lady Yi, consort of Shun, as companion.

sentences.zh: 天郊所祭曰皇天之神，以太祖武皇帝配。

translations.literal: What is sacrificed at the Heavenly Suburb is titled Spirit of Imperial Heaven, with the Great Ancestor Emperor Wu as companion.
translations.idiomatic: What is sacrificed at the Heavenly Suburb is titled Spirit of Imperial Heaven, with the Great Ancestor Emperor Wu as companion.

sentences.zh: 地郊所祭曰皇地之祇，以武宣皇后配。

translations.literal: What is sacrificed at the Earthly Suburb is titled Spirit of Imperial Earth, with Empress Wu Xuan as companion.
translations.idiomatic: What is sacrificed at the Earthly Suburb is titled Spirit of Imperial Earth, with Empress Wu Xuan as companion.

sentences.zh: 宗祀皇考高祖文皇帝於明堂，以配上帝。

translations.literal: In ancestral sacrifice, the late father, the High Ancestor Emperor Wen, is honored at the Bright Hall as companion to the Supreme Lord.
translations.idiomatic: In ancestral sacrifice, the late father, the High Ancestor Emperor Wen, is honored at the Bright Hall as companion to the Supreme Lord.

sentences.zh: 」十二月壬子冬至，始祀皇皇帝天于圓丘，以始祖有虞帝舜配。

translations.literal: "On the day renzi of the twelfth month, the winter solstice, sacrifice to Imperial Imperial Emperor Heaven at the Round Mound began, with the founding ancestor Emperor Shun of Youyu as companion.
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi day of the twelfth month, the winter solstice, sacrifice to Imperial Imperial Emperor Heaven at the Round Mound began, with the founding ancestor Emperor Shun of Youyu as companion.

sentences.zh: 自正始以後，終魏世，不復郊祀。

translations.literal: From Zhengshi onward, through the end of the Wei dynasty, suburban sacrifice was not performed again.
translations.idiomatic: From the Zhengshi era onward, through the end of Wei, suburban sacrifice was never performed again.

sentences.zh: 孫權初稱尊號於武昌，祭南郊告天。

translations.literal: When Sun Quan first assumed the exalted title at Wuchang, he sacrificed at the southern suburb to announce to Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: When Sun Quan first assumed the imperial title at Wuchang, he sacrificed at the southern suburb to announce his accession to Heaven.

sentences.zh: 文曰：「皇帝臣孫權，敢用玄牡，昭告皇皇后帝。

translations.literal: The text reads: "The Emperor, your subject Sun Quan, ventures to use a black bull to announce clearly to Imperial Imperial Emperor and Empress.
translations.idiomatic: The text reads: "The Emperor, your subject Sun Quan, ventures to use a black bull to announce clearly to Imperial Imperial Emperor and Empress.

sentences.zh: 漢饗國二十有四世，歷年四百三十有四，行氣數終，祿胙運盡，普天弛絕，率土分崩。

translations.literal: Han enjoyed the state for twenty-four generations, spanning four hundred and thirty-four years; its cycle of qi and numbers ended, its blessings and fortunes were exhausted, all under Heaven was loosened and cut off, and throughout the realm the land split apart.
translations.idiomatic: Han enjoyed the state for twenty-four generations, spanning four hundred and thirty-four years; its cycle of cosmic force and fate ran its course, its blessings and fortunes were exhausted, all under Heaven fell into disorder, and the realm split apart.

sentences.zh: 孽臣曹丕，遂奪神器。

translations.literal: The wicked minister Cao Pi then seized the sacred vessel.
translations.idiomatic: The wicked minister Cao Pi then seized the imperial regalia.

sentences.zh: 丕子叡繼世作慝，竊名亂制。

translations.literal: Pi's son Rui succeeded him in doing evil and usurped titles to disorder the institutions.
translations.idiomatic: Cao Pi's son Cao Rui succeeded him in wickedness and usurped titles to disorder the institutions.

sentences.zh: 權生於東南，遭值期運，承乾秉戎，志在拯世，奉辭行罰，舉足為民。

translations.literal: Quan was born in the southeast, encountered the appointed fortune, received Heaven and took up arms, his will set on saving the age, bearing the mandate to execute punishment—every step was for the people.
translations.idiomatic: Quan was born in the southeast, encountered the appointed fortune, received Heaven's mandate and took up arms, his will set on saving the age, bearing the mandate to execute punishment—every step was taken for the people.

sentences.zh: 羣臣將相州郡百城執事之人，咸以為天意已去於漢，漢氏已終於天，皇帝位虛，郊祀無主，休徵嘉瑞，前後雜沓，曆數在躬，不得不受。

translations.literal: Ministers, generals, chancellors, and officials of the hundred cities in the provinces and commanderies all considered that Heaven's will had already departed from Han, the Han house had ended in Heaven, the imperial seat was vacant, suburban sacrifice had no lord, auspicious signs and fine omens came one after another in profusion, and the succession was upon his person—he could not but accept.
translations.idiomatic: Ministers, generals, chancellors, and officials of the hundred cities in the provinces and commanderies all held that Heaven's will had already departed from Han, the Han house had ended by Heaven's decree, the imperial seat stood empty, suburban sacrifice had no lord, auspicious signs and fine omens came one after another in profusion, and the succession rested upon his person—he could not but accept.

sentences.zh: 權畏天命，敢不敬從。

translations.literal: Quan feared Heaven's command and dared not fail to obey reverently.
translations.idiomatic: Quan feared Heaven's command and dared not fail to obey reverently.

sentences.zh: 謹擇元日，登壇柴燎，即皇帝位。

translations.literal: He respectfully chose the first day, ascended the altar with firewood burning, and assumed the imperial position.
translations.idiomatic: He respectfully chose the auspicious day, ascended the altar with firewood burning, and assumed the imperial throne.

sentences.zh: 唯爾有神饗之！

translations.literal: May you, the spirits, partake of this!
translations.idiomatic: May you, the spirits, accept this offering!

sentences.zh: 左右有吳，永綏天極。

translations.literal: May Wu be sustained on left and right, and Heaven's pole be forever tranquil.
translations.idiomatic: May Wu be sustained on every side, and Heaven's pole be forever tranquil.

sentences.zh: 」其後自以居非中土，不復修設。

translations.literal: "Thereafter, considering that his residence was not in the central lands, he did not restore or establish the rites again.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter, considering that his residence was not in the central lands, he did not restore or establish the rites again.

sentences.zh: 中年，羣臣奏議，宜修郊祀。

translations.literal: In his middle years, the ministers submitted a memorial proposing that suburban sacrifice should be restored.
translations.idiomatic: In his middle years, the ministers submitted a memorial proposing that suburban sacrifice should be restored.

sentences.zh: 權曰：「郊祀當於中土，今非其所。

translations.literal: Quan said: "Suburban sacrifice should be performed in the central lands; the present place is not the proper one.
translations.idiomatic: Quan said: "Suburban sacrifice should be performed in the central lands; the present place is not the proper one.

sentences.zh: 」重奏曰：「普天之下，莫非王土。

translations.literal: "They submitted again: "All under Heaven—none is not the king's land.
translations.idiomatic: They submitted again: "All under Heaven—none is not the king's land.

sentences.zh: 王者以天下為家。

translations.literal: The king takes all under Heaven as his home.
translations.idiomatic: A king takes all under Heaven as his home.

sentences.zh: 昔周文、武郊於酆、鎬，非必中土。

translations.literal: Formerly King Wen and King Wu sacrificed at the suburbs in Feng and Hao—not necessarily in the central lands.
translations.idiomatic: Formerly King Wen and King Wu sacrificed at the suburbs in Feng and Hao—not necessarily in the central lands.

sentences.zh: 」權曰：「武王伐紂，即阼於鎬京，而郊其所也。

translations.literal: "Quan said: "King Wu attacked Zhou and took the throne at Haojing, and sacrificed at the suburbs in the place where he had assumed the throne.
translations.idiomatic: Quan said: "King Wu attacked Zhou and took the throne at Haojing, and sacrificed at the suburbs in the place where he had assumed the throne.

sentences.zh: 文王未為天子，立郊於酆，見何經典？

translations.literal: King Wen had not yet become Son of Heaven when he established suburban sacrifice at Feng—in what classic is this seen?
translations.idiomatic: King Wen had not yet become Son of Heaven when he established suburban sacrifice at Feng—in what classic is this seen?

sentences.zh: 」復奏曰：「伏見漢書郊祀志，匡衡奏徙甘泉河東郊於長安，言文王郊於酆。

translations.literal: "They submitted again: "We have seen in the Treatise on Suburban Sacrifices in the Book of Han that Kuang Heng memorialized moving the suburban sacrifices from Ganquan and Hedong to Chang'an, stating that King Wen sacrificed at the suburbs in Feng.
translations.idiomatic: They submitted again: "We have seen in the Treatise on Suburban Sacrifices in the Book of Han that Kuang Heng memorialized moving the suburban sacrifices from Ganquan and Hedong to Chang'an, stating that King Wen sacrificed at the suburbs in Feng.

sentences.zh: 」權曰：「文王德性謙讓，處諸侯之位，明未郊也。

translations.literal: "Quan said: "King Wen's virtue was humble and yielding; he occupied the position of a feudal lord—it is clear he had not yet sacrificed at the suburbs.
translations.idiomatic: Quan said: "King Wen's virtue was humble and yielding; he occupied the position of a feudal lord—it is clear he had not yet sacrificed at the suburbs.

sentences.zh: 經傳無明文，由匡衡俗儒意說，非典籍正義，不可用也。

translations.literal: The classics and commentaries have no clear text on this; it derives from the vulgar scholar Kuang Heng's arbitrary interpretation, not the correct meaning of the canonical texts, and cannot be used.
translations.idiomatic: The classics and commentaries have no clear text on this; it derives from the vulgar scholar Kuang Heng's arbitrary interpretation, not the correct meaning of the canonical texts, and cannot be used.

sentences.zh: 」虞喜志林曰：「吳主糾駁郊祀，追貶匡衡，凡在見者，莫不慨然稱善也。

translations.literal: "Yu Xi's Forest of Records says: "The Lord of Wu corrected and refuted the suburban sacrifices and pursued condemnation of Kuang Heng; all who witnessed it none failed to sigh with approval and praise it.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Xi's Forest of Records says: "The Lord of Wu corrected and refuted the suburban sacrifices and pursued condemnation of Kuang Heng; all who witnessed it sighed with approval and praised him.

sentences.zh: 」何承天曰：「案權建號繼天，而郊享有闕，固非也。

translations.literal: "He Chengtian says: "Considering that Quan established his title and succeeded Heaven, yet his suburban sacrifices were deficient—this was certainly wrong.
translations.idiomatic: He Chengtian says: "Considering that Quan established his title and succeeded Heaven, yet his suburban sacrifices were deficient—this was certainly wrong.

sentences.zh: 末年雖一南郊，而遂無北郊之禮。

translations.literal: In his final years, although he performed one southern suburb sacrifice, he then had no northern suburb rite.
translations.idiomatic: In his final years, although he performed one southern suburb sacrifice, he then had no northern suburb rite.

sentences.zh: 環氏吳紀：『權思崇嚴父配天之義，追上父堅尊號為吳始祖。

translations.literal: Huan's Annals of Wu: "Quan wished to exalt the principle of honoring the father as companion to Heaven, and posthumously advanced his father Jian with the exalted title Founding Ancestor of Wu.
translations.idiomatic: Huan's Annals of Wu: "Quan wished to exalt the principle of honoring the father as companion to Heaven, and posthumously advanced his father Sun Jian with the exalted title Founding Ancestor of Wu.

sentences.zh: 』如此說，則權末年所郊，堅配天也。

translations.literal: "If this account is so, then in Quan's final years at the suburban sacrifice, Jian was companion to Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: If this account is correct, then in Quan's final years at the suburban sacrifice, Sun Jian served as Heaven's companion.

sentences.zh: 權卒後，三嗣主終吳世不郊祀，則權不享配帝之禮矣。」

translations.literal: After Quan's death, the three successor lords through the end of Wu performed no suburban sacrifice—thus Quan did not enjoy the rite of companion to the Lord."
translations.idiomatic: After Quan's death, the three successor rulers through the end of Wu performed no suburban sacrifice—thus Quan never enjoyed the rite of companion to the Supreme Lord."

sentences.zh: 劉備章武元年，即皇帝位，設壇。

translations.literal: In the first year of Zhangwu of Liu Bei, he assumed the imperial position and set up an altar.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Zhangwu, Liu Bei assumed the imperial throne and set up an altar.

sentences.zh: 「建安二十六年夏四月丙午，皇帝臣備，敢用玄牡，昭告皇天上帝、后土神祇。

translations.literal: "On the day bingwu of the fourth month of summer in the twenty-sixth year of Jian'an, the Emperor, your subject Bei, ventures to use a black bull to announce clearly to Imperial Heaven, the Supreme Lord, and the spirits of Earth.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingwu day of the fourth month of summer in the twenty-sixth year of Jian'an, the Emperor, your subject Liu Bei, ventures to use a black bull to announce clearly to Imperial Heaven, the Supreme Lord, and the spirits of Earth.

sentences.zh: 漢有天下，曆數無疆。

translations.literal: Han possessed all under Heaven, and its succession was without limit.
translations.idiomatic: Han possessed all under Heaven, and its succession was without limit.

sentences.zh: 曩者王莽篡盜，光武皇帝震怒致誅，社稷復享。

translations.literal: Formerly Wang Mang usurped and stole the throne; Emperor Guangwu in wrath executed punishment, and the altars of soil and grain were restored.
translations.idiomatic: Formerly Wang Mang usurped the throne; Emperor Guangwu in wrath executed punishment, and the altars of soil and grain were restored.

sentences.zh: 今曹操阻兵安忍，子丕載其凶逆，竊居神器。

translations.literal: Now Cao Cao obstructed the army and was cruel and forbearing; his son Pi carried on his wicked rebellion and usurped the sacred vessel.
translations.idiomatic: Now Cao Cao obstructed the army and was cruel and forbearing; his son Cao Pi carried on his wicked rebellion and usurped the imperial regalia.

sentences.zh: 羣臣將士以為社稷墮廢，備宜修之，嗣武二祖，龔行天罰。

translations.literal: Ministers and generals considered that the altars of soil and grain had fallen into ruin and Bei should restore them, succeeding the martial virtue of the two ancestors and carrying out Heaven's punishment.
translations.idiomatic: Ministers and generals held that the altars of soil and grain had fallen into ruin and Bei should restore them, succeeding the martial virtue of the two ancestors and carrying out Heaven's punishment.

sentences.zh: 備惟否德，懼忝帝位，詢于庶民，外及蠻夷君長，僉曰天命不可以不答，祖業不可以久替，四海不可以無主，率土式望，在備一人。

translations.literal: Bei alone lacks virtue and fears disgracing the imperial position; he inquired of the common people, and extending outward to the chieftains of the barbarians, all said Heaven's command cannot go unanswered, the ancestral enterprise cannot long be set aside, the four seas cannot be without a lord—all the realm looked in hope to Bei alone.
translations.idiomatic: Bei alone lacks virtue and fears disgracing the imperial throne; he inquired of the common people, and extending outward to the chieftains of the barbarians, all said Heaven's command cannot go unanswered, the ancestral enterprise cannot long be set aside, the four seas cannot be without a lord—all the realm looked in hope to Bei alone.

sentences.zh: 備畏天之威，又懼漢邦將湮于地。

translations.literal: Bei feared Heaven's majesty and also feared that the Han domain would sink into the earth.
translations.idiomatic: Bei feared Heaven's majesty and also feared that the Han domain would perish from the earth.

sentences.zh: 謹擇元日，與百僚登壇，受皇帝璽綬。

translations.literal: He respectfully chose the first day, ascended the altar with the hundred officials, and received the imperial seal-cord.
translations.idiomatic: He respectfully chose the auspicious day, ascended the altar with the hundred officials, and received the imperial seal and cord.

sentences.zh: 修燔瘞，告類于大神。

translations.literal: He performed burning and burial offerings and announced the category to the great spirits.
translations.idiomatic: He performed burning and burial offerings and announced his accession to the great spirits.

sentences.zh: 惟大神尚饗！

translations.literal: May the great spirits partake!
translations.idiomatic: May the great spirits accept this offering!

sentences.zh: 祚于漢家，永綏四海。」

translations.literal: May fortune rest upon the house of Han and forever bring peace to the four seas."
translations.idiomatic: May fortune rest upon the house of Han and forever bring peace to the four seas."

sentences.zh: 章武二年十月，詔丞相諸葛亮營南北郊于成都。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the second year of Zhangwu, an edict ordered Chancellor Zhuge Liang to construct the southern and northern suburbs at Chengdu.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the second year of Zhangwu, an edict ordered Chancellor Zhuge Liang to construct the southern and northern suburban altars at Chengdu.

sentences.zh: 魏元帝咸熙二年十二月甲子，使持節侍中太保鄭沖、兼太尉司隸校尉李憙奉皇帝璽綬策書，禪帝位于晉。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi of the twelfth month of the second year of Xixi of Emperor Yuan of Wei, Commissioner with the Staff of Authority, Palace Attendant, and Grand Guardian Zheng Chong, together with Acting Grand Commandant and Director of the Secretariat Li Xi, presented the imperial seal-cord and abdication decree, abdicating the imperial position to Jin.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiazi day of the twelfth month of the second year of Xixi under Emperor Yuan of Wei, Commissioner with the Staff of Authority, Palace Attendant, and Grand Guardian Zheng Chong, together with Acting Grand Commandant and Director of the Secretariat Li Xi, presented the imperial seal and cord along with the abdication decree, yielding the throne to Jin.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，晉設壇場于南郊，柴燎告類，未有祖配。

translations.literal: On the day bingyin, Jin set up the altar platform at the southern suburb, burned firewood to announce the category, and had no ancestral accompaniment.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingyin day, Jin set up the altar platform at the southern suburb, burned firewood to announce the accession, and performed no ancestral accompaniment.

sentences.zh: 其文曰：「皇帝臣炎，敢用玄牡，明告于皇皇后帝。

translations.literal: The text reads: "The Emperor, your subject Yan, ventures to use a black bull to announce clearly to Imperial Imperial Emperor and Empress.
translations.idiomatic: The text reads: "The Emperor, your subject Sima Yan, ventures to use a black bull to announce clearly to Imperial Imperial Emperor and Empress.

sentences.zh: 魏帝稽協皇運，紹天明命，以命炎曰：『昔者唐堯禪位虞舜，虞舜又以禪禹，邁德垂訓，多歷年載。

translations.literal: The Emperor of Wei examined and harmonized with the imperial fortune, continuing Heaven's bright command, and commanded Yan, saying: "Formerly Tang Yao abdicated to Yu Shun, and Yu Shun in turn abdicated to Yu—passing down virtue and leaving instruction through many years.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor of Wei examined and harmonized with the imperial fortune, continuing Heaven's bright command, and commanded Yan, saying: "Formerly Tang Yao abdicated to Yu Shun, and Yu Shun in turn abdicated to Yu—passing down virtue and leaving instruction through many years.

sentences.zh: 暨漢德既衰，太祖武皇帝撥亂濟民，扶翼劉氏，又用受禪于漢。

translations.literal: When Han virtue had declined, the Great Ancestor Emperor Wu quelled disorder and aided the people, supported the Liu house, and in turn received the abdication from Han.
translations.idiomatic: When Han virtue had declined, the Great Ancestor Emperor Wu quelled disorder and aided the people, supported the Liu house, and in turn received the abdication from Han.

sentences.zh: 粵在魏室，仍世多故，幾於顛墜，實賴有晉匡拯之德，用獲保厥肆祀，弘濟于艱難。

translations.literal: In the house of Wei, generation after generation had many troubles and nearly fell into ruin; it truly relied on Jin's virtue of righting and saving, thereby obtaining preservation of its sacrifices and great aid in hardship.
translations.idiomatic: In the house of Wei, generation after generation faced many troubles and nearly fell into ruin; it truly relied on Jin's virtue of righting and saving, thereby preserving its sacrifices and receiving great aid in hardship.

sentences.zh: 此則晉之有大造于魏也。

translations.literal: This is Jin's great achievement for Wei.
translations.idiomatic: This is the great debt Jin owed to Wei.

sentences.zh: 誕惟四方之民，罔不祗順，開國建侯，宣禮明刑，廓清梁、岷，苞懷揚、越，函夏興仁，八紘同軌，遐邇馳義，祥瑞屢臻，天人協應，無思不服。

translations.literal: Extending to the people of the four directions, none failed to obey reverently; founding states and establishing marquisates, proclaiming ritual and clarifying punishments, clearing Liang and Min, embracing Yang and Yue, within Xia benevolence arose, the eight cords shared one track, far and near hastened in righteousness, auspicious omens repeatedly arrived, Heaven and humanity harmonized in response—none who thought of it failed to submit.
translations.idiomatic: Extending to the people of the four directions, none failed to obey reverently; founding states and establishing marquisates, proclaiming ritual and clarifying punishments, clearing Liang and Min, embracing Yang and Yue, within the central lands benevolence arose, the eight directions shared one track, far and near hastened in righteousness, auspicious omens repeatedly arrived, Heaven and humanity harmonized in response—none who considered it failed to submit.

sentences.zh: 肆予憲章三后，用集大命于茲。

translations.literal: Therefore I take as model the three sovereigns and thereby gather the great command here.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore I take as model the three sovereigns and thereby gather the great Mandate here.

sentences.zh: 』炎惟德不嗣，辭不獲命。

translations.literal: "Yan alone lacked virtue to succeed and in declining could not obtain permission.
translations.idiomatic: Yan alone lacked virtue to succeed and in declining could not obtain permission.

sentences.zh: 於是羣公卿士，百辟庶僚，黎獻陪隸，暨于百蠻君長，僉曰：『皇天鑒下，求民之瘼，既有成命，固非克讓所得距違。

translations.literal: Thereupon the dukes, ministers, scholars, the hundred officials and common functionaries, the people and attendant servants, extending to the chieftains of the hundred barbarians, all said: "Imperial Heaven looks down, seeking the people's afflictions; since the accomplished command already exists, it truly cannot be resisted by declining.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon the dukes, ministers, scholars, the hundred officials and common functionaries, the people and attendant servants, extending to the chieftains of the hundred barbarians, all said: "Imperial Heaven looks down, seeking the people's afflictions; since the accomplished command already exists, it truly cannot be resisted by declining.

sentences.zh: 』天序不可以無統，人神不可以曠主，炎虔奉皇運，畏天之威，敢不欽承休命，敬簡元辰，升壇受禪，告類上帝，以永答民望，敷佑萬國。

translations.literal: "Heaven's order cannot be without succession; humanity and the spirits cannot be without a lord. Yan reverently received the imperial fortune, feared Heaven's majesty, and dared not fail to accept the fine command respectfully, respectfully choosing the first day, ascending the altar to receive the abdication, announcing the category to the Supreme Lord, thereby forever answering the people's hope and spreading blessing over the myriad states.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven's order cannot be without succession; humanity and the spirits cannot be without a lord. Yan reverently received the imperial fortune, feared Heaven's majesty, and dared not fail to accept the fine command respectfully, respectfully choosing the auspicious day, ascending the altar to receive the abdication, announcing his accession to the Supreme Lord, thereby forever answering the people's hope and spreading blessing over the myriad states.

sentences.zh: 惟明德是饗。」

translations.literal: May only the bright virtue be partaken of."
translations.idiomatic: May only the bright virtue be accepted."

sentences.zh: 泰始二年正月，詔曰：「有司前奏郊祀權用魏禮。

translations.literal: In the first month of the second year of Taishi, an edict said: "The responsible officials previously memorialized that suburban sacrifice should provisionally use Wei's rites.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the second year of Taishi, an edict said: "The responsible officials previously memorialized that suburban sacrifice should provisionally use Wei's rites.

sentences.zh: 朕不慮改作之難，今便為永制。

translations.literal: I did not consider the difficulty of changing and establishing anew; now let it be made the permanent institution.
translations.idiomatic: I did not consider the difficulty of changing and establishing anew; now let it be made the permanent institution.

sentences.zh: 眾議紛互，遂不時定，不得以時供饗神祀，配以祖考，日夕歎企，貶食忘安。

translations.literal: The multitude of discussions were confused and intermingled, and thus it was not settled in season; I could not in season offer sacrifice to the spirits and gods with the ancestors and late fathers as companions—day and night I sighed and looked forward, reducing my food and forgetting rest.
translations.idiomatic: The multitude of discussions were confused and intermingled, and thus it was not settled in season; I could not in season offer sacrifice to the spirits and gods with the ancestors and late fathers as companions—day and night I sighed and looked forward, reducing my food and forgetting rest.

sentences.zh: 其便郊祀。

translations.literal: Let suburban sacrifice be performed forthwith.
translations.idiomatic: Let suburban sacrifice be performed forthwith.

sentences.zh: 」時羣臣又議：「五帝，即天也，五氣時異，故殊其號。

translations.literal: "At this time the ministers again discussed: "The Five Emperors are Heaven; the five qi differ with the seasons, and therefore their titles differ.
translations.idiomatic: At this time the ministers again discussed: "The Five Emperors are Heaven; the five cosmic forces differ with the seasons, and therefore their titles differ.

sentences.zh: 雖名有五，其實一神。

translations.literal: Although the names are five, in reality it is one spirit.
translations.idiomatic: Although the names are five, in reality it is one deity.

sentences.zh: 明堂南郊，宜除五帝之坐。

translations.literal: At the Bright Hall and southern suburb, the seats of the Five Emperors should be removed.
translations.idiomatic: At the Bright Hall and southern suburb, the seats of the Five Emperors should be removed.

sentences.zh: 五郊改五精之號，皆同稱昊天上帝，各設一坐而已。

translations.literal: The five suburbs should change the titles of the five essences; all alike are titled August Heaven Supreme Lord, each with only one seat established.
translations.idiomatic: At the five suburbs, the titles of the five essences should be changed; all alike are titled August Heaven Supreme Lord, with only one seat established for each.

sentences.zh: 北郊又除先后配祀。

translations.literal: At the northern suburb, the accompanying sacrifice of the former and later empresses was also removed.
translations.idiomatic: At the northern suburb, the accompanying sacrifice of the former and later empresses was also removed.

sentences.zh: 」帝悉從之。

translations.literal: The emperor followed all of this.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor accepted all of these proposals.

sentences.zh: 二月丁丑，郊祀宣皇帝以配天，宗祀文皇帝於明堂，以配上帝。

translations.literal: On the day dingchou of the second month, he sacrificed at the suburbs to Emperor Xuan as companion to Heaven, and performed ancestral sacrifice to Emperor Wen at the Bright Hall as companion to the Supreme Lord.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingchou day of the second month, he sacrificed at the suburbs to Emperor Xuan as Heaven's companion and performed ancestral sacrifice to Emperor Wen at the Bright Hall as companion to the Supreme Lord.

sentences.zh: 是年十一月，有司又議奏：「古者丘郊不異，宜并圓丘方澤於南北郊，更修治壇兆。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of that year, the responsible officials again memorialized: "In antiquity the mound altar and suburban sacrifice were not different; the Round Mound and Square Pond should be combined with the southern and northern suburbs, and the altar sites should be repaired anew.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of that year, the responsible officials again memorialized: "In antiquity the mound altar and suburban sacrifice were not distinct; the Round Mound and Square Pond should be combined with the southern and northern suburbs, and the altar sites should be repaired anew.

sentences.zh: 其二至之祀，合於二郊。

translations.literal: The sacrifices of the two solstices should be combined with the two suburbs.
translations.idiomatic: The sacrifices of the two solstices should be combined with the two suburbs.

sentences.zh: 」帝又從之。

translations.literal: The emperor again followed this.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor again accepted this proposal.

sentences.zh: 一如宣帝所用王肅議也。

translations.literal: It was entirely like the proposal of Wang Su used by Emperor Xuan.
translations.idiomatic: This followed entirely the proposal of Wang Su that Emperor Xuan had adopted.

sentences.zh: 是月庚寅冬至，帝親祠圓丘於南郊。

translations.literal: In that month, on the day gengyin at the winter solstice, the emperor personally sacrificed at the Round Mound in the southern suburb.
translations.idiomatic: In that month, on the gengyin day at the winter solstice, the emperor personally sacrificed at the Round Mound in the southern suburb.

sentences.zh: 自是後，圓丘方澤不別立至今矣。

translations.literal: From this time onward, the Round Mound and Square Pond have not been separately established down to the present.
translations.idiomatic: From this time onward, the Round Mound and Square Pond have not been separately established down to the present.

sentences.zh: 太康十年十月，乃更詔曰：「孝經『郊祀后稷以配天，宗祀文王於明堂，以配上帝』。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the tenth year of Taikang, another edict said: "The Classic of Filial Piety says, 'Sacrifice at the suburbs to Hou Ji as companion to Heaven; perform ancestral sacrifice to King Wen at the Bright Hall as companion to the Supreme Lord.'
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the tenth year of Taikang, another edict said: "The Classic of Filial Piety says, 'Sacrifice at the suburbs to Hou Ji as companion to Heaven; perform ancestral sacrifice to King Wen at the Bright Hall as companion to the Supreme Lord.'

sentences.zh: 而周官云：『祀天旅上帝。

translations.literal: Yet the Offices of Zhou says: 'In sacrificing to Heaven, present offerings to the Supreme Lord.'
translations.idiomatic: Yet the Offices of Zhou says: 'In sacrificing to Heaven, present offerings to the Supreme Lord.'

sentences.zh: 』又曰：『祀地旅四望。

translations.literal: It also says: 'In sacrificing to Earth, present offerings to the Four Expanse.'
translations.idiomatic: It also says: 'In sacrificing to Earth, present offerings to the Four Expanse.'

sentences.zh: 』四望非地，則明上帝不得為天也。

translations.literal: The Four Expanse are not Earth, which makes clear that the Supreme Lord cannot be Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: The Four Expanse are not Earth, which makes clear that the Supreme Lord cannot be Heaven.

sentences.zh: 往者眾議除明堂五帝位，考之禮文正經不通。

translations.literal: Formerly the multitude discussed removing the Five Emperors' seats from the Bright Hall; examined against ritual texts and canonical classics, this does not accord.
translations.idiomatic: Formerly the multitude discussed removing the Five Emperors' seats from the Bright Hall; examined against ritual texts and canonical classics, this does not accord.

sentences.zh: 且詩序曰：『文、武之功，起於后稷。

translations.literal: Moreover the Preface to the Odes says: 'The achievements of Wen and Wu began with Hou Ji.'
translations.idiomatic: Moreover the Preface to the Odes says: 'The achievements of Wen and Wu began with Hou Ji.'

sentences.zh: 』故推以配天焉。

translations.literal: Therefore he is advanced as companion to Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore he is advanced as companion to Heaven.

sentences.zh: 宣帝以神武創業，既已配天，復以先帝配天，於義亦不安。

translations.literal: Emperor Xuan by divine martial prowess founded the enterprise and was already companion to Heaven; to have the former emperor again as companion to Heaven is also improper in principle.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Xuan by divine martial prowess founded the enterprise and was already Heaven's companion; to have the former emperor again as Heaven's companion is also improper in principle.

sentences.zh: 其復明堂及南郊五帝位。」

translations.literal: Let the Five Emperors' seats at the Bright Hall and southern suburb be restored."
translations.idiomatic: Let the Five Emperors' seats at the Bright Hall and southern suburb be restored."

sentences.zh: 晉武帝太康三年正月，帝親郊祀。

translations.literal: In the first month of the third year of Taikang of Emperor Wu of Jin, the emperor personally performed suburban sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the third year of Taikang, Emperor Wu of Jin personally performed suburban sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 皇太子、皇弟、皇子悉侍祠，非前典也。

translations.literal: The crown prince, imperial younger brothers, and imperial sons all attended the sacrifice—this was not a former precedent.
translations.idiomatic: The crown prince, imperial younger brothers, and imperial sons all attended the sacrifice—this was not a former precedent.

sentences.zh: 愍帝都長安，未及立郊廟而敗。

translations.literal: Emperor Min was at Chang'an and had not yet time to establish suburban temples before defeat.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Min was at Chang'an and had not yet time to establish suburban temples before defeat.

sentences.zh: 元帝中興江南，太興元年，始更立郊兆。

translations.literal: When Emperor Yuan restored the dynasty south of the Yangzi, in the first year of Taixing he first rebuilt the suburban shrine sites.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Yuan restored the dynasty south of the Yangzi, in the first year of Taixing he first rebuilt the suburban shrine sites.

sentences.zh: 其制度皆太常賀循依據漢、晉之舊也。

translations.literal: The institutions all followed the Han and Jin precedents according to the Minister of Ceremonies He Xun.
translations.idiomatic: The institutions all followed Han and Jin precedents as laid out by Minister of Ceremonies He Xun.

sentences.zh: 三月辛卯，帝親郊祀，饗配之禮，一依武帝始郊故事。

translations.literal: On the day xinmao of the third month, the emperor personally performed suburban sacrifice; the rites of offering and accompaniment all followed the precedent of Emperor Wu's first suburban sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinmao day of the third month, the emperor personally performed suburban sacrifice; the rites of offering and accompaniment all followed the precedent of Emperor Wu's first suburban sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 初尚書令刁協、國子祭酒杜夷，議宜須旋都洛邑乃修之。

translations.literal: Initially Minister of the Secretariat Diao Xie and Director of the Imperial Academy Du Yi discussed that one should wait until the capital was moved back to Luoyang before restoring them.
translations.idiomatic: Initially Minister of the Secretariat Diao Xie and Director of the Imperial Academy Du Yi argued that restoration should wait until the capital returned to Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 司徒荀組據漢獻帝居許，即便立郊，自宜於此修奉。

translations.literal: Minister of Works Xun Zu cited that when Emperor Xian of Han resided at Xu, he immediately established the suburbs; it was fitting to restore and perform them here.
translations.idiomatic: Minister of Works Xun Zu cited that when Emperor Xian of Han resided at Xu, he immediately established the suburbs; it was fitting to restore and perform them here.

sentences.zh: 驃騎王導、僕射荀崧、太常華恒、中書侍郎庾亮皆同組議。

translations.literal: Swift Cavalry General Wang Dao, Vice Director Xun Song, Minister of Ceremonies Hua Heng, and Secretariat Gentleman Yu Liang all agreed with Zu's proposal.
translations.idiomatic: Swift Cavalry General Wang Dao, Vice Director Xun Song, Minister of Ceremonies Hua Heng, and Secretariat Gentleman Yu Liang all agreed with Zu's proposal.

sentences.zh: 事遂施行。

translations.literal: The matter was then carried out.
translations.idiomatic: The matter was then carried out.

sentences.zh: 按元帝紹命中興，依漢氏故事，宜享明堂宗祀之禮。

translations.literal: Considering that Emperor Yuan in his restoration mandate followed Han precedents, he should have enjoyed the Bright Hall ancestral sacrifice rites.
translations.idiomatic: Considering that Emperor Yuan in his restoration mandate followed Han precedents, he should have enjoyed the Bright Hall ancestral sacrifice rites.

sentences.zh: 江左不立明堂，故闕焉。

translations.literal: East of the Yangzi no Bright Hall was established, and therefore this was omitted.
translations.idiomatic: East of the Yangzi no Bright Hall was established, and therefore this was omitted.

sentences.zh: 明帝太寧三年七月，始詔立北郊。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the third year of Taining of Emperor Ming, an edict first ordered establishment of the northern suburb.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the third year of Taining of Emperor Ming, an edict first ordered establishment of the northern suburb.

sentences.zh: 未及建而帝崩，故成帝咸和八年正月，追述前旨，於覆舟山南立之。

translations.literal: Before construction was completed the emperor died; therefore in the first month of the eighth year of Xianhe of Emperor Cheng, following the earlier intent, it was established south of Mount Fuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Before construction was completed the emperor died; therefore in the first month of the eighth year of Xianhe of Emperor Cheng, following the earlier intent, it was established south of Mount Fuzhou.

sentences.zh: 是月辛未，祀北郊，始以宣穆張皇后配地。

translations.literal: On the day xinwei of that month, the northern suburb was sacrificed to; for the first time Empress Xuanmu Zhang was taken as companion to Earth.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinwei day of that month, the northern suburb was sacrificed to; for the first time Empress Xuanmu Zhang served as Earth's companion.

sentences.zh: 魏氏故事，非晉舊也。

translations.literal: This was a Wei precedent, not a Jin old institution.
translations.idiomatic: This was a Wei precedent, not an old Jin institution.

sentences.zh: 康帝建元元年正月，將北郊，有疑議。

translations.literal: In the first month of the first year of Jianyuan of Emperor Kang, as the northern suburb was about to be performed, there was disputed discussion.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the first year of Jianyuan of Emperor Kang, as the northern suburb was about to be performed, there was disputed discussion.

sentences.zh: 太常顧和表曰：「泰始中，合二至之祀於二郊。

translations.literal: Minister of Ceremonies Gu He memorialized: "In the Taishi period, the sacrifices of the two solstices were combined with the two suburbs.
translations.idiomatic: Minister of Ceremonies Gu He memorialized: "In the Taishi period, the sacrifices of the two solstices were combined with the two suburbs.

sentences.zh: 北郊之月，古無明文，或以夏至，或同用陽復。

translations.literal: The month for the northern suburb has no clear text in antiquity; some use the summer solstice, or likewise use the return of yang.
translations.idiomatic: The month for the northern suburb has no clear text in antiquity; some use the summer solstice, or likewise use the return of yang.

sentences.zh: 漢光武正月辛未，始建北郊。

translations.literal: Emperor Guangwu of Han, on the day xinwei of the first month, first established the northern suburb.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Guangwu of Han, on the xinwei day of the first month, first established the northern suburb.

sentences.zh: 此則與南郊同月。

translations.literal: Thus it was in the same month as the southern suburb.
translations.idiomatic: Thus it was in the same month as the southern suburb.

sentences.zh: 及中興草創，百度從簡，合北郊於一丘。

translations.literal: At the restoration when institutions were newly established, the hundred regulations were simplified, and the northern suburb was combined on one mound.
translations.idiomatic: At the restoration when institutions were newly established, the hundred regulations were simplified, and the northern suburb was combined on one mound.

sentences.zh: 憲章未備，權用斯禮，蓋時宜也。

translations.literal: The statutes were not complete; provisionally this rite was used—this was what the time required.
translations.idiomatic: The statutes were not complete; provisionally this rite was used—this was what the time required.

sentences.zh: 至咸和中，議別立北郊，同用正月。

translations.literal: By the Xianhe period, discussion proposed separately establishing the northern suburb, using the same first month.
translations.idiomatic: By the Xianhe period, discussion proposed separately establishing the northern suburb, using the same first month.

sentences.zh: 魏承後漢，正月祭天，以地配，而稱周禮，三王之郊，一用夏正。

translations.literal: Wei inherited Later Han and in the first month sacrificed to Heaven with Earth as companion, yet called it Zhou ritual—that the suburban sacrifices of the three kings all used the first month of summer.
translations.idiomatic: Wei inherited Later Han and in the first month sacrificed to Heaven with Earth as companion, yet called it Zhou ritual—that the suburban sacrifices of the three kings all used the first month of summer.

sentences.zh: 」於是從和議。

translations.literal: Thereupon they followed He's proposal.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon they followed He's proposal.

sentences.zh: 是月辛未，南郊。

translations.literal: On the day xinwei of that month, the southern suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinwei day of that month, the southern suburb sacrifice was performed.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，北郊。

translations.literal: On the day xinsi, the northern suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinsi day, the northern suburb sacrifice was performed.

sentences.zh: 帝皆親奉。

translations.literal: The emperor personally performed both.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor personally performed both.

sentences.zh: 安帝元興三年三月，宋高祖討桓玄走之。

translations.literal: In the third month of the third year of Yuanxing of Emperor An, the founding emperor of Song pursued Huan Xuan in defeat.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the third year of Yuanxing of Emperor An, the founding emperor of Song pursued Huan Xuan in defeat.

sentences.zh: 己卯，告義功于南郊。

translations.literal: On the day jimao, he announced the merit of the righteous enterprise at the southern suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao day, he announced the merit of the righteous enterprise at the southern suburb.

sentences.zh: 是年，帝蒙塵江陵未返。

translations.literal: That year the emperor was in exile at Jiangling and had not returned.
translations.idiomatic: That year the emperor was in exile at Jiangling and had not returned.

sentences.zh: 其明年應郊。

translations.literal: The following year the suburban sacrifice was due.
translations.idiomatic: The following year the suburban sacrifice was due.

sentences.zh: 朝議以為宜依周禮，宗伯攝職，三公行事。

translations.literal: Court discussion held that one should follow Zhou ritual, with the Minister of Rites acting in proxy and the Three Dukes performing the ceremony.
translations.idiomatic: Court discussion held that one should follow Zhou ritual, with the Minister of Rites acting in proxy and the Three Dukes performing the ceremony.

sentences.zh: 尚書左丞王訥之獨曰：「既殯郊祀，自是天子當陽，有君存焉，禀命而行，何所辨也。

translations.literal: Left Assistant Director of the Secretariat Wang Nazhi alone said: "Since the suburban sacrifice follows the burial, it is naturally the Son of Heaven who should face the sun; with a lord present, one receives the command and acts—what is there to distinguish?
translations.idiomatic: Left Assistant Director of the Secretariat Wang Nazhi alone said: "Since the suburban sacrifice follows the burial, it is naturally the Son of Heaven who should face the sun; with a lord present, one receives the command and acts—what is there to distinguish?

sentences.zh: 齋之與否，豈如今日之比乎。

translations.literal: Whether to fast or not—how can it be compared to today?
translations.idiomatic: Whether to fast or not—how can it be compared to the present situation?

sentences.zh: 議者又云今宜郊，故是承制所得命三公行事。

translations.literal: Those discussing also said that the suburban sacrifice should now be performed, and therefore it was by imperial command that the Three Dukes should perform the ceremony.
translations.idiomatic: Those discussing also said that the suburban sacrifice should now be performed, and therefore it was by imperial command that the Three Dukes should perform the ceremony.

sentences.zh: 又郊天極尊，唯一而已，故非天子不祀也。

translations.literal: Moreover sacrifice to Heaven is supremely exalted—there is only one; therefore none but the Son of Heaven performs sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover sacrifice to Heaven is supremely exalted—there is only one; therefore none but the Son of Heaven performs sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 庶人以上，莫不蒸嘗，嫡子居外，庶子執事，禮文炳然。

translations.literal: Commoners and above all perform seasonal offerings; when the heir resides outside, the secondary son performs the service—the ritual texts are brilliantly clear.
translations.idiomatic: Commoners and above all perform seasonal offerings; when the heir resides outside, the secondary son performs the service—the ritual texts are brilliantly clear.

sentences.zh: 未有不親受命而可祭天者。

translations.literal: There has never been one who could sacrifice to Heaven without personally receiving the command.
translations.idiomatic: There has never been one who could sacrifice to Heaven without personally receiving the command.

sentences.zh: 又武皇受禪，用二月郊，元帝中興，以三月郊。

translations.literal: Moreover Emperor Wu received the abdication and used the second month for suburban sacrifice; Emperor Yuan at the restoration used the third month.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover Emperor Wu received the abdication and used the second month for suburban sacrifice; Emperor Yuan at the restoration used the third month.

sentences.zh: 今郊時未過，日望輿駕。

translations.literal: Now the time for suburban sacrifice has not passed, and day by day one looks for the imperial carriage.
translations.idiomatic: Now the time for suburban sacrifice has not passed, and day by day one looks for the imperial carriage.

sentences.zh: 無為欲速而無據，使皇輿旋返，更不得親奉。

translations.literal: Do not, wishing for speed without basis, cause the imperial carriage to turn back so that he can no longer perform it personally.
translations.idiomatic: Do not, wishing for speed without basis, cause the imperial carriage to turn back so that he can no longer perform it personally.

sentences.zh: 」遂從訥之議。

translations.literal: They thereupon followed Nazhi's proposal.
translations.idiomatic: They thereupon followed Nazhi's proposal.

sentences.zh: 晉恭帝元熙二年五月，遣使奉策，禪帝位于宋。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the second year of Yuanxi of Emperor Gong of Jin, envoys were dispatched bearing the written decree, abdicating the imperial position to Song.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the second year of Yuanxi of Emperor Gong of Jin, envoys were dispatched bearing the written decree, yielding the throne to Song.

sentences.zh: 永初元年六月丁卯，設壇南郊，受皇帝璽紱，柴燎告類。

translations.literal: On the day dingmao of the sixth month of the first year of Yongchu, an altar was set up at the southern suburb; he received the imperial seal-cord, burned firewood and announced the category.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingmao day of the sixth month of the first year of Yongchu, an altar was set up at the southern suburb; he received the imperial seal and cord, burned firewood and announced his accession.

sentences.zh: 策曰：「皇帝臣裕，敢用玄牡，昭告皇皇后帝。

translations.literal: The decree read: "The Emperor, your subject Yu, ventures to use a black bull to announce clearly to Imperial Imperial Emperor and Empress.
translations.idiomatic: The decree read: "The Emperor, your subject Liu Yu, ventures to use a black bull to announce clearly to Imperial Imperial Emperor and Empress.

sentences.zh: 晉帝以卜世告終，曆數有歸，欽若景運，以命于裕。

translations.literal: The Emperor of Jin announced that his allotted span had ended and the succession had its destination; reverently following the bright fortune, he commanded Yu.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor of Jin announced that his allotted span had ended and the succession had its destination; reverently following the bright fortune, he commanded Yu.

sentences.zh: 夫樹君司民，天下為公，德充帝王，樂推攸集。

translations.literal: To establish a lord and govern the people—the realm is public; when virtue fills the imperial position, the people's joyful submission gathers.
translations.idiomatic: To establish a lord and govern the people—the realm is public; when virtue fills the imperial position, the people's joyful submission gathers.

sentences.zh: 越俶唐、虞，降暨漢、魏，靡不以上哲格文祖，元勳陟帝位，故能大拯黔黎，垂訓無窮。

translations.literal: Transcending Tang and Yu, descending to Han and Wei, none failed to have the supreme sage attain the culture-ancestor and the founding merit ascend the imperial position, thereby greatly saving the black-haired people and leaving instruction without end.
translations.idiomatic: Transcending Tang and Yu, descending to Han and Wei, none failed to have the supreme sage attain the culture-ancestor and the founding merit ascend the imperial position, thereby greatly saving the black-haired people and leaving instruction without end.

sentences.zh: 晉自東遷，四維弗樹，宰輔焉依，為日已久。

translations.literal: Since Jin moved east, the four bonds were not established and one relied on chancellors and assistants—for many days already.
translations.idiomatic: Since Jin moved east, the four bonds were not established and one relied on chancellors and assistants—for many days already.

sentences.zh: 難棘隆安，禍成元興，遂至帝王遷播，宗祀湮滅。

translations.literal: Hardship pricked at Long'an, disaster formed at Yuanxing, reaching the point where emperors and kings were driven away and ancestral sacrifices were extinguished.
translations.idiomatic: Hardship pricked at Long'an, disaster formed at Yuanxing, reaching the point where emperors and kings were driven away and ancestral sacrifices were extinguished.

sentences.zh: 裕雖地非齊、晉，眾無一旅，仰憤時難，俯悼橫流，投袂一麾，則皇祚剋復。

translations.literal: Though Yu's territory was not like Qi and Jin and his hosts were not a single brigade, looking up he grieved at the age's hardship and looking down he mourned the flood of calamity; with a wave of his sleeve he restored the imperial fortune.
translations.idiomatic: Though Yu's territory was not like Qi and Jin and his hosts were not a single brigade, looking up he grieved at the age's hardship and looking down he mourned the flood of calamity; with a wave of his sleeve he restored the imperial fortune.

sentences.zh: 及危而能持，顛而能扶，姦宄具殲，僭偽必滅。

translations.literal: In danger he could hold firm, in overturn he could support; traitors and villains were all destroyed, usurpers and pretenders were certainly extinguished.
translations.idiomatic: In danger he could hold firm, in overturn he could support; traitors and villains were all destroyed, usurpers and pretenders were certainly extinguished.

sentences.zh: 誠否終必泰，興廢有期。

translations.literal: Truly, denial ends and peace must come; rise and fall have their season.
translations.idiomatic: Truly, denial ends and peace must come; rise and fall have their season.

sentences.zh: 至於撥亂濟民，大造晉室，因藉時運，以尸其勞。

translations.literal: As for quelling disorder and aiding the people, the great achievement for the house of Jin—by relying on the fortune of the time, he undertook its labors.
translations.idiomatic: As for quelling disorder and aiding the people, the great achievement for the house of Jin—by relying on the fortune of the time, he undertook its labors.

sentences.zh: 加以殊俗慕義，重譯來款，正朔所暨，咸服聲教。

translations.literal: Moreover foreign peoples admired righteousness and came with repeated tribute at the border; wherever the calendar reached, all submitted to the transforming influence.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover foreign peoples admired righteousness and came with repeated tribute at the border; wherever the calendar reached, all submitted to the transforming influence.

sentences.zh: 至乃三靈垂象，山川告祥，人神和協，歲月茲著。

translations.literal: Even the three numina displayed omens, mountains and rivers reported auspicious signs, humanity and the spirits harmonized, and the years bore witness.
translations.idiomatic: Even the three numina displayed omens, mountains and rivers reported auspicious signs, humanity and the spirits harmonized, and the years bore witness.

sentences.zh: 是以羣公卿士，億兆夷人，僉曰皇靈隆鑒於上，晉朝款誠於下，天命不可以久淹，宸極不可以暫曠。

translations.literal: Therefore the dukes, ministers, scholars, and the hundred million common people all said the imperial spirits looked down with lofty scrutiny and the Jin court showed sincerity below; Heaven's command cannot long be delayed, the imperial throne cannot briefly stand vacant.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore the dukes, ministers, scholars, and the hundred million common people all said the imperial spirits looked down with lofty scrutiny and the Jin court showed sincerity below; Heaven's command cannot long be delayed, the imperial throne cannot briefly stand vacant.

sentences.zh: 遂逼羣議，恭茲大禮。

translations.literal: Thus compelled by the multitude's discussion, he respectfully performed this great rite.
translations.idiomatic: Thus compelled by the multitude's discussion, he respectfully performed this great rite.

sentences.zh: 猥以寡德，託于兆民之上。

translations.literal: Humbly with meager virtue, he was placed above the hundred million people.
translations.idiomatic: Humbly with meager virtue, he was placed above the hundred million people.

sentences.zh: 雖仰畏天威，略是小節，顧深永懷，祗懼若厲。

translations.literal: Though looking up in awe of Heaven's majesty is a small matter, he turned his thoughts to what lay far ahead and in reverent fear was as if in peril.
translations.idiomatic: Though looking up in awe of Heaven's majesty is a small matter, he turned his thoughts to what lay far ahead and in reverent fear was as if in peril.

sentences.zh: 敬簡元日，升壇受禪，告類上帝，用酬萬國之嘉望。

translations.literal: Respectfully choosing the first day, he ascended the altar to receive the abdication, announced the category to the Supreme Lord, thereby answering the myriad states' fine hope.
translations.idiomatic: Respectfully choosing the auspicious day, he ascended the altar to receive the abdication, announced his accession to the Supreme Lord, thereby answering the myriad states' fine hope.

sentences.zh: 克隆天保，永祚于有宋。

translations.literal: May the heavenly blessing be duplicated and fortune forever rest upon Song.
translations.idiomatic: May the heavenly blessing be duplicated and fortune forever rest upon Song.

sentences.zh: 惟明靈是饗。」

translations.literal: May the bright spirits partake!"
translations.idiomatic: May the bright spirits accept this offering!"

sentences.zh: 永初元年，皇太子拜告南北郊。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yongchu, the crown prince paid respects and announced at the southern and northern suburbs.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Yongchu, the crown prince paid respects and announced at the southern and northern suburbs.

sentences.zh: 永初二年正月上辛，上親郊祀。

translations.literal: On the upper xin day of the first month of the second year of Yongchu, the emperor personally performed suburban sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: On the upper xin day of the first month of the second year of Yongchu, the emperor personally performed suburban sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 文帝元嘉三年，車駕西征謝晦，幣告二郊。

translations.literal: In the third year of Yuanjia of Emperor Wen, as the imperial carriage campaigned west against Xie Hui, silks were offered to announce at the two suburbs.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Yuanjia of Emperor Wen, as the imperial carriage campaigned west against Xie Hui, silks were offered to announce at the two suburbs.

sentences.zh: 孝武帝孝建元年六月癸巳，八座奏：「劉義宣、臧質，干時犯順，滔天作戾，連結淮、岱，謀危宗社。

translations.literal: On the day guisi of the sixth month of the first year of Xiaojian of Emperor Xiaowu, the Eight Ministers memorialized: "Liu Yixuan and Zang Zhi, defying the time and violating obedience, filled Heaven with wickedness, linking Huai and Dai in conspiracy against the altars of state.
translations.idiomatic: On the guisi day of the sixth month of the first year of Xiaojian of Emperor Xiaowu, the Eight Ministers memorialized: "Liu Yixuan and Zang Zhi, defying the time and violating obedience, filled Heaven with wickedness, linking Huai and Dai in conspiracy against the altars of state.

sentences.zh: 質反之始，戒嚴之日，二郊廟社，皆已遍陳。

translations.literal: From the day when Zhi first rebelled and the army was placed on alert, the two suburbs, temples, and altars had all already been fully announced.
translations.idiomatic: From the day when Zhi first rebelled and the army was placed on alert, the two suburbs, temples, and altars had all already been fully announced.

sentences.zh: 其義宣為逆，未經同告。

translations.literal: Yixuan's rebellion had not yet been jointly announced.
translations.idiomatic: Yixuan's rebellion had not yet been jointly announced.

sentences.zh: 輿駕將發，醜徒冰消，質既梟懸，義宣禽獲，二寇俱殄，並宜昭告。

translations.literal: As the imperial carriage was about to set out, the wicked troops melted away; Zhi was already displayed on the gibbet and Yixuan captured—both rebels were destroyed and all should be clearly announced.
translations.idiomatic: As the imperial carriage was about to set out, the wicked troops melted away; Zhi was already displayed on the gibbet and Yixuan captured—both rebels were destroyed and all should be clearly announced.

sentences.zh: 檢元嘉三年討謝晦之始，普告二郊、太廟。

translations.literal: Examining the beginning of the campaign against Xie Hui in the third year of Yuanjia, announcement was made everywhere at the two suburbs and the Imperial Temple.
translations.idiomatic: Examining the beginning of the campaign against Xie Hui in the third year of Yuanjia, announcement was made everywhere at the two suburbs and the Imperial Temple.

sentences.zh: 賊既平蕩，唯告太廟、太社，不告二郊。

translations.literal: When the rebels were pacified, announcement was made only at the Imperial Temple and Grand Altar of Soil and Grain, not at the two suburbs.
translations.idiomatic: When the rebels were pacified, announcement was made only at the Imperial Temple and Grand Altar of Soil and Grain, not at the two suburbs.

sentences.zh: 」禮官博議。

translations.literal: The ritual officials broadly discussed.
translations.idiomatic: The ritual officials broadly discussed.

sentences.zh: 太學博士徐宏、孫勃、陸澄議：「禮無不報。

translations.literal: Erudites of the Imperial Academy Xu Hong, Sun Bo, and Lu Cheng discussed: "In ritual there is no failure to report.
translations.idiomatic: Erudites of the Imperial Academy Xu Hong, Sun Bo, and Lu Cheng discussed: "In ritual there is no failure to report.

sentences.zh: 始既遍告，今賊已禽，不應不同。

translations.literal: Since at the beginning announcement was made everywhere, now that the rebels have been captured, they should not differ.
translations.idiomatic: Since at the beginning announcement was made everywhere, now that the rebels have been captured, they should not differ.

sentences.zh: 」國子助教蘇瑋生議：「案王制，天子巡狩，『歸，假于祖禰』。

translations.literal: Assistant Instructor of the National University Su Weisheng discussed: "Considering the Royal Regulations: when the Son of Heaven tours, 'upon return, he rests at the ancestral temples of father and forefather.'
translations.idiomatic: Assistant Instructor of the National University Su Weisheng discussed: "Considering the Royal Regulations: when the Son of Heaven tours, 'upon return, he rests at the ancestral temples of father and forefather.'

sentences.zh: 又曾子問：『諸侯適天子，告于祖，奠于禰，命祝史告于社稷宗廟山川。

translations.literal: In Zengzi's Questions it also says: 'When feudal lords go to the Son of Heaven, they announce at the ancestor, set out offerings at the forefather, and command the invocator-historian to announce at the altars of soil and grain, ancestral temple, mountains, and rivers.
translations.idiomatic: In Zengzi's Questions it also says: 'When feudal lords go to the Son of Heaven, they announce at the ancestor, set out offerings at the forefather, and command the invocator-historian to announce at the altars of soil and grain, ancestral temple, mountains, and rivers.

sentences.zh: 告用牲幣，反亦如之。

translations.literal: Announcement uses victims and silks; upon return it is likewise.'
translations.idiomatic: Announcement uses victims and silks; upon return it is likewise.'

sentences.zh: 諸侯相見，反必告于祖禰，乃命祝史告至于前所告者。

translations.literal: When feudal lords meet one another, upon return they must announce to the ancestral temples, then command the invocator-scribe to announce arrival to those previously announced to.
translations.idiomatic: When lords paid visits to one another, they always announced their return to the ancestral temples, then ordered the invocator-scribe to report their arrival at every shrine that had been notified before they set out.

sentences.zh: 』又云：『天子諸侯將出，必以幣帛皮圭，告于祖禰。

translations.literal: " It also says: "When the Son of Heaven and feudal lords are about to set out, they must with silk, cloth, leather, and jade tablets announce to the ancestral temples.
translations.idiomatic: It also states: "Before the Son of Heaven or any feudal lord departed, silk offerings, hides, and jade tokens had to be presented in announcement at the ancestral temples.

sentences.zh: 反必告至。

translations.literal: Upon return they must announce arrival.
translations.idiomatic: On returning, they had to announce that they had arrived safely.

sentences.zh: 』天子諸侯，雖事有小大，其禮略鈞，告出告至，理不得殊。

translations.literal: " Though affairs of the Son of Heaven and feudal lords may be great or small, their ritual is broadly equal—announcement on departure and announcement on arrival, by principle cannot differ.
translations.idiomatic: Whether the business was great or small, the rites for the Son of Heaven and for feudal lords were broadly the same: the duty to announce on departure and on return could not logically differ.

sentences.zh: 鄭云：『出入禮同。

translations.literal: Zheng says: "The ritual for going out and coming in is the same.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng Xuan comments: "The ceremonies for departure and return are identical.

sentences.zh: 』其義甚明。

translations.literal: " The meaning is very clear.
translations.idiomatic: That meaning is perfectly clear.

sentences.zh: 天子出征，類于上帝，推前所告者歸必告至，則宜告郊，不復容疑。

translations.literal: When the Son of Heaven campaigns, he performs the border sacrifice to the Supreme Lord; extending from those previously announced to, upon return he must announce arrival—then he ought to announce at the suburban sacrifice, no further room for doubt.
translations.idiomatic: When the Son of Heaven went to war, he performed the border sacrifice to the Supreme Lord; by the same logic that required announcing one's return to every shrine notified before departure, announcing at the suburban altars was obligatory and left no room for doubt.

sentences.zh: 元嘉三年，唯告廟社，未詳其義。

translations.literal: In Yuanjia year three, they only announced to the temple and Grand Altar— the reason is not clear.
translations.idiomatic: In Yuanjia 3, only the temple and Grand Altar of Soil and Grain were notified; the reasoning behind that choice remains unclear.

sentences.zh: 或當以禮記唯云『歸假祖禰』，而無告郊之辭。

translations.literal: Perhaps they took it that the Book of Rites only says "upon return rest at the ancestral temples," and has no wording about announcing at the suburban sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: Perhaps they relied on the Book of Rites passage that speaks only of "returning to rest at the ancestral temples," with no mention of announcing at the suburbs.

sentences.zh: 果立此義，彌所未達。

translations.literal: If indeed this principle is established, it is what I understand least.
translations.idiomatic: If that was truly their rationale, I cannot fathom it at all.

sentences.zh: 夫禮記殘缺之書，本無備體，折簡敗字，多所闕略。

translations.literal: For the Book of Rites is a damaged and incomplete text, originally without perfect form; broken slips and corrupted characters, much omitted and abbreviated.
translations.idiomatic: The Book of Rites is a damaged work to begin with, never a complete compendium; broken bamboo slips and corrupted characters have left countless gaps.

sentences.zh: 正應推例求意，不可動必徵文。

translations.literal: One should properly extend precedent to seek the meaning; one cannot always insist on textual proof for every action.
translations.idiomatic: The proper course is to infer meaning from parallel examples, not to demand explicit wording for every step.

sentences.zh: 天子反行告社，亦無成記，何故告郊，獨當致嫌。

translations.literal: When the Son of Heaven returns and announces to the Grand Altar, there is also no established record— why should announcing at the suburban sacrifice alone draw objection?
translations.idiomatic: Even the emperor's return announcement at the Grand Altar of Soil and Grain has no fixed precedent in the records—why should announcing at the suburbs alone be treated as suspect?

sentences.zh: 但出入必告，蓋孝敬之心。

translations.literal: Yet going out and coming in must be announced— this is fundamentally the heart of filial reverence.
translations.idiomatic: The requirement to announce departure and return springs from filial reverence—it is nothing more than that.

sentences.zh: 既以告歸為義，本非獻捷之禮。

translations.literal: Since the meaning is announcing the return, fundamentally it is not the ritual of presenting victory.
translations.idiomatic: The point is to announce one's safe return, not to perform the rite of presenting a military victory.

sentences.zh: 今輿駕竟未出宮，無容有告至之文。

translations.literal: Now the imperial carriage has not yet left the palace— there can be no wording of announcing arrival.
translations.idiomatic: On this occasion the emperor's procession never left the palace—there is no occasion for a return-announcement text.

sentences.zh: 若陳告不行之禮，則為未有前准。

translations.literal: If one sets forth the ritual of announcing the campaign did not take place, then there is no prior standard.
translations.idiomatic: To invent a ceremony announcing that the campaign was never launched would be without any precedent.

sentences.zh: 愚謂祝史致辭，以昭誠信。

translations.literal: I consider that the invocator-scribe delivering the invocation is to display sincerity and trust.
translations.idiomatic: I take the invocator-scribe's formal declaration to be a matter of signaling sincerity and good faith.

sentences.zh: 苟其義舛於禮，自可從實而闕。

translations.literal: If the meaning conflicts with ritual, naturally one may omit it according to the facts.
translations.idiomatic: When the rite's logic does not fit the facts, it is right to omit the declaration altogether.

sentences.zh: 臣等參議，以應告為允，宜並用牲告南北二郊、太廟、太社，依舊公卿行事。

translations.literal: We Your subjects jointly deliberated and judge that it is proper to announce; it is suitable jointly to use sacrificial victims to announce at the southern and northern suburban sacrifices, the Grand Temple, and the Grand Altar— following the established practice of the ministers and grandees.
translations.idiomatic: We have deliberated together and hold that announcements are appropriate: victims should be offered in announcement at both suburban altars, the Grand Temple, and the Grand Altar of Soil and Grain, with the great ministers officiating as in former practice.

sentences.zh: 」詔可。

translations.literal: " The edict approved.
translations.idiomatic: The edict approved it.

sentences.zh: 孝建二年正月庚寅，有司奏：「今月十五日南郊。

translations.literal: In the first month of Xiaojian year two, on day gengyin, the responsible officials memorialized: "On the fifteenth of this month is the southern suburban sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day in the first month of Xiaojian 2, the responsible officials submitted: "The southern suburban sacrifice falls on the fifteenth of this month.

sentences.zh: 尋舊儀，廟祠至尊親奉，以太尉亞獻；

translations.literal: Looking to former practice, at temple sacrifices the Most High personally officiates, with the Grand Commandant performing the secondary libation;
