translations.literal: Respectfully seeking, suburban and ancestral two sacrifices— though names differ, substance is the same; as for requiring announcement, there can be no difference.
translations.idiomatic: The suburban and ancestral sacrifices, though named differently, are substantially the same; as for requiring announcement, there can be no difference.

sentences.zh: 」守尚書令袁粲等並同延秀議。

translations.literal: Acting Director of the Masters of Writing Yuan Can and others all agreed with Yanxiu's proposal.
translations.idiomatic: Acting Director of the Masters of Writing Yuan Can and others all agreed with Wang Yanxiu's proposal.

sentences.zh: 魏明帝世，中護軍蔣濟奏曰：「夫帝王大禮，巡狩為先；

translations.literal: In Emperor Ming of Wei's time, Central Guard General Jiang Ji memorialized: "For the great ritual of emperors and kings, inspection tours come first;
translations.idiomatic: During the reign of Emperor Ming of Wei, Central Guard General Jiang Ji memorialized: "For emperors and kings, the great rituals begin with inspection tours;

sentences.zh: 昭祖揚禰，封禪為首。

translations.literal: illuminating ancestors and spreading merit to forefathers, feng and shan come foremost.
translations.idiomatic: and illuminating ancestors and spreading merit to forefathers—the feng and shan rites come foremost.

sentences.zh: 是以自古革命受符，未有不蹈梁父，登泰山，刊無竟之名，紀天人之際者也。

translations.literal: Thus from ancient times receiving the mandate through revolution, none failed to tread Liangfu, ascend Mount Tai, inscribe names without end, recording the juncture of Heaven and Man.
translations.idiomatic: Thus from ancient times, none who received the mandate through revolution failed to tread Liangfu, ascend Mount Tai, inscribe an enduring name, and record the juncture of Heaven and Man.

sentences.zh: 故司馬相如謂有文以來七十二君，或從所繇於前，謹遺跡於後。

translations.literal: Thus Sima Xiangru said that since writing began, seventy-two rulers— some followed what preceded, carefully leaving traces for those after.
translations.idiomatic: Sima Xiangru said that since writing began, seventy-two rulers had done so—some following predecessors, carefully leaving traces for those who came after.

sentences.zh: 太史公曰：『主上有聖明而不宣布，有司之過也。

translations.literal: Grand Historian said: 'When the ruler above has sage brilliance yet does not proclaim it, it is the responsible officials' fault.'
translations.idiomatic: The Grand Historian said: 'When the ruler above has sage brilliance yet does not proclaim it, it is the responsible officials' fault.'

sentences.zh: 』然則元功懿德，不刊山、梁之石，無以顯帝王之功，布生民不朽之觀也。

translations.literal: Then primordial merit and beautiful virtue, not inscribed on Mount Tai and Liangfu stone— cannot display the emperor's achievement, spread the people's immortal vision.
translations.idiomatic: Primordial merit and beautiful virtue, if not inscribed on the stones of Mount Tai and Liangfu, cannot display the emperor's achievement or spread the people's immortal vision.

sentences.zh: 語曰，當君而歎堯、舜之美，譬猶人子對厥所生，譽他人之父。

translations.literal: The saying goes: facing one's ruler and sighing over Yao and Shun's beauty is like a son facing his own parent and praising another man's father.
translations.idiomatic: As the saying goes: to face one's ruler and sigh over the beauty of Yao and Shun is like a son praising another man's father before his own.

sentences.zh: 今大魏振百王之弊亂，拯流遁之艱危，接千載之衰緒，繼百世之廢治。

translations.literal: Now Great Wei shakes the hundred kings' corrupt disorder, saves those adrift in peril, connects a thousand years' declining thread, continues a hundred generations' abandoned governance.
translations.idiomatic: Great Wei now shakes off the corrupt disorder of a hundred kings, saves those adrift in peril, connects a thousand years of decline, and continues a hundred generations of abandoned governance.

sentences.zh: 自武、文至于聖躬，所以參成天地之道，綱維人神之化，上天報應，嘉瑞顯祥，以比往古，其優衍豐隆，無所取喻。

translations.literal: From Wu and Wen down to the sage person— thus completing Heaven and Earth's Way, netting human and spirit transformation; Heaven above responds, auspicious omens appear manifest— compared with former ages, its abundance and grandeur have no comparison.
translations.idiomatic: From Wu and Wen down to the present sage, the dynasty has completed Heaven and Earth's Way and governed the transformation of human and spirit; Heaven responds above and auspicious omens appear—compared with former ages, its abundance and grandeur have no parallel.

sentences.zh: 至於歷世迄今，未發大禮。

translations.literal: As for generations to the present, the great ritual has not been performed.
translations.idiomatic: Yet down to the present generation the great ritual has not been performed.

sentences.zh: 雖志在掃盡殘盜，蕩滌餘穢，未遑斯事。

translations.literal: Though the will is to sweep away remaining bandits and wash away leftover filth, there has been no leisure for this affair.
translations.idiomatic: Though the will is to sweep away remaining bandits and wash away leftover filth, there has been no leisure for this affair.

sentences.zh: 若爾，三苗堀強於江海，大舜當廢東巡之儀，徐夷跳梁於淮、泗，周成當止岱嶽之禮也。

translations.literal: If so, when the Three Miao were stubborn in rivers and seas, Great Shun should have abolished the eastern tour ritual; when Xu and Yi leaped about Huai and Si, King Cheng of Zhou should have stopped the Taishan ritual.
translations.idiomatic: If so, when the Three Miao were stubborn in rivers and seas, Great Shun should have abolished the eastern tour ritual; when Xu and Yi rebelled on the Huai and Si, King Cheng of Zhou should have stopped the Taishan ritual.

sentences.zh: 且昔歲破吳虜於江、漢，今茲屠蜀賊於隴右。

translations.literal: Moreover last year Wu bandits were broken at Jiang and Han; this year Shu bandits were slaughtered at Longyou.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover last year Wu bandits were broken at the Jiang and Han; this year Shu bandits were destroyed at Longyou.

sentences.zh: 其震蕩內潰，在不復淹，就當探其窟穴，無累於封禪之事也。

translations.literal: Their shock and internal collapse— in no long time again— should then probe their dens and lairs, without burdening the feng and shan affair.
translations.idiomatic: Their shock and internal collapse will not long endure; we should probe their dens and lairs without letting the feng and shan rite be burdened.

sentences.zh: 此儀久廢，非倉卒所定。

translations.literal: This ritual long abandoned— not something decided in haste.
translations.idiomatic: This ritual has long been abandoned and cannot be decided in haste.

sentences.zh: 宜下公卿，廣纂其禮，卜年考時，昭告上帝，以副天下之望。

translations.literal: It is suitable to refer to the ministers and grandees, broadly compile its ritual, divine the year and examine the time, brightly announce to the Supreme Lord, to match the realm's hope.
translations.idiomatic: It is suitable to refer the matter to the ministers and grandees, broadly compile the ritual, divine the year and examine the time, and solemnly announce to the Supreme Lord, to match the realm's hope.

sentences.zh: 臣待罪軍旅，不勝大願，冒死以聞。

translations.literal: Your subject awaiting punishment in the army, unable to bear the great wish, risking death to report.
translations.idiomatic: I await punishment in the army yet cannot suppress this great wish, and so risk death to report it.

sentences.zh: 」詔曰：「聞濟斯言，使吾汗出流足。

translations.literal: Edict: "Hearing Ji's words makes my sweat flow down my feet.
translations.idiomatic: The edict replied: "Hearing Ji's words makes sweat flow down my feet.

sentences.zh: 自開闢以來，封禪者七十餘君爾。

translations.literal: Since opening and beginning, those performing feng and shan are only seventy-odd rulers.
translations.idiomatic: Since the opening of the age, only seventy-odd rulers have performed the feng and shan.

sentences.zh: 故太史公曰：『雖有受命之君，而功有不洽，是以中間曠遠者，千有餘年，近數百載。

translations.literal: Thus Grand Historian said: 'Though there are rulers receiving the mandate, yet achievement is not complete— thus in the middle the distant interval is over a thousand years, near several hundred years.
translations.idiomatic: The Grand Historian also said: 'Though there are rulers receiving the mandate, achievement is not complete—thus the distant interval spans over a thousand years, the near several hundred.

sentences.zh: 其儀闕不可得記。

translations.literal: Its ritual gaps cannot be recorded.'
translations.idiomatic: Its ritual gaps cannot be recorded.'

sentences.zh: 』吾何德之修，敢庶茲乎。

translations.literal: What virtue do I cultivate, that I dare hope for this?
translations.idiomatic: What virtue have I cultivated that I should dare hope for such a thing?

sentences.zh: 濟豈謂世無管仲，以吾有桓公登泰山之志乎。

translations.literal: Does Ji mean that the age has no Guan Zhong, and that I have Duke Huan's ambition to ascend Mount Tai?
translations.idiomatic: Does Ji mean there is no Guan Zhong in the age, and that I harbor Duke Huan's ambition to ascend Mount Tai?

sentences.zh: 吾不敢欺天也。

translations.literal: I dare not deceive Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: I would not dare deceive Heaven.

sentences.zh: 濟之所言，華則華矣，非助我者也。

translations.literal: Ji's words are splendid indeed, yet they do not assist me.
translations.idiomatic: What Ji said is splendid indeed, yet it does not help me.

sentences.zh: 公卿侍中、尚書、常侍省之而已。

translations.literal: Ministers, attendants within, Masters of Writing, and regular attendants— let them review it and that is all.
translations.idiomatic: Let the ministers, attendants within, Masters of Writing, and regular attendants review it and that is all.

sentences.zh: 勿復有所議，亦不須答詔也。

translations.literal: Do not again offer deliberations, and there is also no need to reply to the edict.
translations.idiomatic: Do not deliberate further, and there is no need to reply to the edict.

sentences.zh: 」帝雖拒濟議，而實使高堂隆草封禪之儀。

translations.literal: Though the emperor rejected Ji's proposal, he actually had Gao Tanglong draft the feng and shan protocol.
translations.idiomatic: Though the emperor rejected Ji's proposal, he actually had Gao Tanglong draft the feng and shan protocol.

sentences.zh: 以天下未一，不欲便行大禮。

translations.literal: Because the realm was not yet unified, he did not wish to perform the great ritual immediately.
translations.idiomatic: Because the realm was not yet unified, he declined to perform the great ritual at once.

sentences.zh: 會隆卒，故不行。

translations.literal: When Long died, therefore it was not performed.
translations.idiomatic: When Long died, the rite was never performed.

sentences.zh: 晉武帝平吳，混一區宇。

translations.literal: Emperor Wu of Jin pacified Wu and unified the realm.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Wu of Jin conquered Wu and unified the realm.

sentences.zh: 太康元年九月庚寅，尚書令衞瓘、尚書左僕射山濤、右僕射魏舒、尚書劉寔、張華等奏曰：「聖德隆茂，光被四表，諸夏乂清，幽荒率從。

translations.literal: Taikang year one ninth month gengyin, Director of the Masters of Writing Wei Guan, Left Assistant Director of the Masters of Writing Shan Tao, Right Assistant Director Wei Shu, Masters of Writing Liu Shi, Zhang Hua and others memorialized: "Sage virtue abundant and flourishing, brilliance covering the four directions, all Xia at peace, the dark and distant all follow.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day of the ninth month in Taikang 1, Wei Guan, Director of the Masters of Writing, Shan Tao, Left Assistant Director, Wei Shu, Right Assistant Director, and Masters of Writing Liu Shi and Zhang Hua submitted: "Sage virtue flourishes and brilliance covers the four directions; all Xia is at peace and the dark and distant all follow.

sentences.zh: 神策廟算，席卷吳越，孫晧稽顙，六合為家，巍巍之功，格于天地。

translations.literal: Divine stratagem and temple calculation, sweeping up Wu and Yue, Sun Hao kowtowing, the six directions one household— towering achievement reaching to Heaven and Earth.
translations.idiomatic: By divine stratagem and temple calculation Wu and Yue were swept away, Sun Hao kowtowed, and the six directions became one household—achievement towering to Heaven and Earth.

sentences.zh: 宜同古典，勒封東嶽，告三府太常為儀制。

translations.literal: It is suitable to follow the ancient canon, inscribe and enfeoff the Eastern Peak, announce to the Three Offices and Minister of Ceremonies for ritual protocol.
translations.idiomatic: It is suitable to follow the ancient canon, inscribe and enfeoff the Eastern Peak, and charge the Three Offices and Minister of Ceremonies with the ritual protocol.

sentences.zh: 」瓘等又奏：「臣聞肇自生民，則有后辟，載祀之數，莫之能紀。

translations.literal: Guan and others again memorialized: "We have heard since the birth of the people there have been rulers; the number of recorded sacrifices cannot be counted.
translations.idiomatic: Guan and others memorialized again: "Since the birth of the people there have been rulers, and the number of recorded sacrifices cannot be counted.

sentences.zh: 立德濟世，揮揚仁風，以登封泰山者七十有四家，其諡號可知者，十有四焉。

translations.literal: Establishing virtue and benefiting the age, spreading benevolent wind— those ascending and enfeoffing Mount Tai number seventy-four houses; of posthumous names knowable, there are fourteen.
translations.idiomatic: Those who established virtue and benefited the age, spreading benevolent wind—seventy-four houses ascended and enfeoffed Mount Tai; of posthumous names knowable, there are fourteen.

sentences.zh: 沈淪寂寞，曾無遺聲者，不可勝記。

translations.literal: Sunk in silence and obscurity, never leaving a trace— those cannot be fully recorded.
translations.idiomatic: Sunk in silence and obscurity, never leaving a trace—those cannot be fully recorded.

sentences.zh: 自黃帝以前，古傳昧略，唐、虞以來，典謨炳著。

translations.literal: Before the Yellow Emperor, ancient transmission is obscure and brief; from Tang and Yu onward, canons and plans shine clearly.
translations.idiomatic: Before the Yellow Emperor ancient transmission is obscure; from Tang and Yu onward canons and plans shine clearly.

sentences.zh: 三王代興，體業繼襲，周道既沒，秦氏承之，至于漢、魏，而質文未復。

translations.literal: Three dynasties rose in succession, substance and enterprise inherited; when Zhou's Way was lost, Qin inherited it— down to Han and Wei, substance and ornament were not restored.
translations.idiomatic: Three dynasties rose in succession, inheriting substance and enterprise; when Zhou's Way was lost Qin inherited it—down to Han and Wei, substance and ornament were not restored.

sentences.zh: 大晉之德，始自重、黎，實佐顓頊，至于夏、商，世序天地，其在于周，不失其緒。

translations.literal: Great Jin's virtue began from Chong and Li, truly assisting Zhuanxu; down to Xia and Shang, generations ordered Heaven and Earth; in Zhou they did not lose the thread.
translations.idiomatic: Great Jin's virtue began with Chong and Li, truly assisting Zhuanxu; through Xia and Shang generations ordered Heaven and Earth; in Zhou they did not lose the thread.

sentences.zh: 金德將升，世濟明聖，外平蜀漢，海內歸心，武功之盛，實由文德。

translations.literal: Metal virtue about to ascend, generations aiding bright sages, outwardly pacifying Shu and Han, the realm within returning hearts— military achievement's splendor truly came from civil virtue.
translations.idiomatic: Metal virtue was about to ascend; generations aided bright sages; Shu and Han were pacified outwardly and hearts returned within—the splendor of military achievement truly came from civil virtue.

sentences.zh: 至于陛下受命踐阼，弘建大業，羣生仰流，唯獨江湖沅湘之表，凶桀負固，歷代不賓。

translations.literal: As for Your Majesty receiving the mandate and ascending the throne, broadly establishing great enterprise, all living beings looking up in flow— only the rivers, lakes, Yuan and Xiang beyond, fierce villains holding firm, through generations not submitting.
translations.idiomatic: When Your Majesty received the mandate and ascended the throne, broadly establishing great enterprise, all living beings looked upward—only beyond the rivers, lakes, Yuan and Xiang did fierce villains hold firm, through generations refusing submission.

sentences.zh: 神謀獨斷，命將出討，兵威暫加，數旬蕩定，覊其鯨鯢，赦其罪逆。

translations.literal: Divine plan and sole decision, commanding generals to campaign; military might briefly applied, in several tens of days swept and settled— binding their whales and minnows, pardoning their crimes and rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: By divine plan and sole decision generals were sent to campaign; military might was briefly applied and in several tens of days all was settled—binding the rebels and pardoning their crimes.

sentences.zh: 雲覆雨施，八方來同，聲教所被，達于四極。

translations.literal: Cloud covering and rain spreading, the eight directions coming together; sound and teaching covered, reaching the four extremities.
translations.idiomatic: Cloud covering and rain spreading, the eight directions came together; sound and teaching reached the four extremities.

sentences.zh: 雖黃軒之征，大禹遠略，周之奕世，何以尚今。

translations.literal: Though Yellow Xuan's campaigns, Great Yu's distant strategy, Zhou's generations of inheritance— how can they compare with today?
translations.idiomatic: Though Yellow Xuan's campaigns, Great Yu's distant strategy, and Zhou's generations of inheritance—how can they compare with today?

sentences.zh: 若夫玄石素文，底號前載，象以姓表，言以事告，河圖、洛書之徵，不是過也。

translations.literal: As for dark stone plain text, inscribing titles in former records, symbols by surname, words by affairs reported— the signs of River Chart and Luo Writing are not excessive.
translations.idiomatic: As for dark stone and plain text inscribing titles in former records, symbols by surname and words reporting affairs—the signs of the River Chart and Luo Writing are not excessive.

sentences.zh: 加以騶虞麟趾，眾瑞並臻。

translations.literal: Added to this zouyu and linzhi, many auspices all arriving together.
translations.idiomatic: Added to this, zouyu and linzhi and many auspices all arrived together.

sentences.zh: 昔夏、殷以丕崇為祥，周武以烏魚為美，咸曰休哉；

translations.literal: Formerly Xia and Yin took great elevation as auspicious, Zhou Wu took black fish as beautiful— all said 'How splendid!'
translations.idiomatic: Formerly Xia and Yin took great elevation as auspicious, Zhou Wu took the black fish as beautiful—all said, 'How splendid!'

sentences.zh: 然符瑞之應，備物之盛，未有若今之富者也。

translations.literal: Yet talisman responses and complete things' splendor— none as rich as today's abundance.
translations.idiomatic: Yet talisman responses and the splendor of complete offerings—none match today's abundance.

sentences.zh: 宜宣大典，禮中嶽，封泰山，禪梁父，發德號，明至尊，享天休，篤黎庶，勒千載之表，播流後之聲，俾百代之下，莫不興起。

translations.literal: It is suitable to proclaim the great canon, ritual at the Central Peak, enfeoff Mount Tai, shan at Liangfu, issue virtue titles, clarify supreme honor, enjoy Heaven's blessing, deepen care for the black-haired people, inscribe the tablet of a thousand ages, spread sound flowing to later ages— so that under a hundred generations none fail to rise up.
translations.idiomatic: It is suitable to proclaim the great canon, perform ritual at the Central Peak, enfeoff Mount Tai, perform shan at Liangfu, issue virtue titles, clarify supreme honor, enjoy Heaven's blessing, deepen care for the people, inscribe the tablet of a thousand ages, and spread renown to later ages—so that under a hundred generations none fail to rise up.

sentences.zh: 斯帝王之盛業，天人之至望也。

translations.literal: This is the emperor's splendid enterprise, Heaven and Man's utmost hope.
translations.idiomatic: This is the emperor's splendid enterprise and Heaven and Man's utmost hope.

sentences.zh: 」詔曰：「今逋寇雖殄，外則障塞有警，內則民黎未康，此盛德之事，所未議也。

translations.literal: Edict: "Now though fleeing bandits are extinguished, outwardly frontier barriers have alarms, inwardly the people are not yet at ease— this splendid virtue affair is not yet for deliberation."
translations.idiomatic: The edict replied: "Though fleeing bandits are extinguished, the frontiers still have alarms and the people are not yet at ease—this splendid virtue affair is not yet for deliberation."

sentences.zh: 」瓘等又奏：「今東漸于海，西被流沙，大漠之陰，日南北戶，莫不通屬。

translations.literal: Guan and others again memorialized: "Now east reaching the sea, west covered by drifting sand, north of the great desert, south to the sun's vertical point— none fail to connect.
translations.idiomatic: Guan and others memorialized again: "Now east to the sea, west to drifting sand, north of the great desert, south to the sun's vertical point—none fail to connect.

sentences.zh: 茫茫禹跡，今實過之，則天人之道已周，巍巍之功已著。

translations.literal: Vast and boundless Yu's traces— today truly surpass them; then Heaven and Man's Way is complete, towering achievement is established.
translations.idiomatic: Vast and boundless, Yu's traces—today we truly surpass them; Heaven and Man's Way is complete and towering achievement established.

sentences.zh: 宜有事梁父，修禮地祇，登封泰山，致誠上帝，以答人神之願。

translations.literal: It is suitable to perform ritual at Liangfu, repair ritual for the Earth Spirit, ascend and enfeoff Mount Tai, extend sincerity to the Supreme Lord, to answer Heaven and Man's wish.
translations.idiomatic: It is suitable to perform ritual at Liangfu, repair ritual for the Earth Spirit, ascend and enfeoff Mount Tai, and extend sincerity to the Supreme Lord to answer Heaven and Man's wish.

sentences.zh: 乞如前奏。

translations.literal: We beg as in the former memorial.
translations.idiomatic: We beg as in the former memorial.

sentences.zh: 」詔曰：「今陰陽未和，政刑未當，百姓未得其所，豈可以勒功告成邪！

translations.literal: Edict: "Now yin and yang are not harmonized, governance and punishment are not proper, the hundred surnames have not obtained their place— how can one inscribe achievement and announce completion!"
translations.idiomatic: The edict replied: "Yin and yang are not harmonized, governance and punishment are not proper, and the people have not obtained their place—how can one inscribe achievement and announce completion?"

sentences.zh: 」瓘又奏：「臣聞處帝王之位者，必有曆運之期，天命之應；

translations.literal: Guan again memorialized: "We have heard those occupying the emperor's position must have a calendrical fortune's term, Heaven's mandate's response;
translations.idiomatic: Guan memorialized again: "We have heard that those occupying the emperor's position must have a calendrical fortune's term and Heaven's mandate's response;

sentences.zh: 濟生民之大功者，必有盛德之容，告成之典。

translations.literal: those accomplishing great merit for the living people must have splendid virtue's countenance, announcement-of-completion canon.
translations.idiomatic: those accomplishing great merit for the living people must have splendid virtue's countenance and the announcement-of-completion canon.

sentences.zh: 無不可誣，有不可讓，自古道也。

translations.literal: Nothing cannot be falsely claimed; something cannot be declined— from ancient Way.
translations.idiomatic: Nothing can be falsely claimed; something cannot be declined—from ancient Way.

sentences.zh: 而明詔謙沖，屢辭其禮。

translations.literal: Yet the bright edict is modest and restrained, repeatedly declining its ritual.
translations.idiomatic: Yet the bright edict is modest and restrained, repeatedly declining its ritual.

sentences.zh: 雖盛德攸在，推而未居。

translations.literal: Though splendid virtue is present, pushed yet not yet occupied.
translations.idiomatic: Though splendid virtue is present, it is pushed yet not yet occupied.

sentences.zh: 夫三公職典天地，實掌民物，國之大事，取議於此。

translations.literal: The Three Dukes' office canon is Heaven and Earth, truly administering the people's things; the state's great affairs take deliberation from this.
translations.idiomatic: The Three Dukes' office canon is Heaven and Earth, truly administering the people's affairs; the state's great affairs take deliberation from this.

sentences.zh: 漢氏封禪，非是官也，不在其事。

translations.literal: Han house feng and shan— this was not that office, not in that affair.
translations.idiomatic: Han feng and shan—this was not that office, not in that affair.

sentences.zh: 臣等前奏，蓋陳祖考之功，天命又應，陛下之德，合同四海，述古考今，宜脩此禮。

translations.literal: Our former memorial probably stated ancestors' achievement, Heaven's mandate again responding, Your Majesty's virtue harmonizing the four seas— examining antiquity and present, it is suitable to repair this ritual.
translations.idiomatic: Our former memorial stated ancestors' achievement and Heaven's mandate responding again; Your Majesty's virtue harmonizes the four seas—examining antiquity and present, it is suitable to repair this ritual.

sentences.zh: 至於剋定歲月，須五府上議，然後奏聞。

translations.literal: As for fixing the year and month, one must await the Five Offices' upward deliberation, then memorial and report.
translations.idiomatic: As for fixing the year and month, one must await the Five Offices' upward deliberation, then memorial and report.

sentences.zh: 請寫詔及奏，如前下議。

translations.literal: Please copy the edict and memorial as before and refer down for deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: Please copy the edict and memorial as before and refer down for deliberation.

sentences.zh: 」詔曰：「雖蕩清江表，皆臨事者之勞，何足以告成。

translations.literal: Edict: "Though Jiang was swept clear, all are the labor of those facing affairs— how is it sufficient to announce completion.
translations.idiomatic: The edict replied: "Though the Jiang was swept clear, that is all the labor of those facing affairs—how is it sufficient to announce completion?

sentences.zh: 方望羣后，思隆大化，以寧區夏，百姓獲乂，與之休息，斯朕日夜之望。

translations.literal: Now looking to the queens and consorts, thinking to exalt great transformation, to bring peace to the regions of Xia, the hundred surnames obtaining governance, resting with them— this is what I hope day and night.
translations.idiomatic: Now I look to the queens and consorts, thinking to exalt great transformation, to bring peace to the realm, the people obtaining governance and resting with them—this is what I hope day and night.

sentences.zh: 無所復下諸府矣。

translations.literal: Nothing further to refer to the various offices.
translations.idiomatic: Nothing further to refer to the various offices.

sentences.zh: 勿復為煩。

translations.literal: Do not again be troublesome.
translations.idiomatic: Do not again be troublesome.

sentences.zh: 」瓘等又奏：「臣聞唐、虞二代，濟世弘功之君，莫不仰答天心，俯協民志，登介丘，履梁父，未有辭焉者，蓋不可讓也。

translations.literal: Guan and others again memorialized: "We have heard Tang and Yu two ages, rulers of great merit benefiting the age— none failed to look up answering Heaven's heart, look down harmonizing the people's will, ascend Jie mound, tread Liangfu— none declined, probably because it cannot be declined.
translations.idiomatic: Guan and others memorialized again: "We have heard that in the two ages of Tang and Yu, rulers of great merit benefiting the age—none failed to look up answering Heaven's heart and look down harmonizing the people's will, ascend Jie mound and tread Liangfu—none declined, probably because it cannot be declined.

sentences.zh: 今陛下勳高百王，德無與二，茂績宏規，巍巍之業，固非臣等所能究論。

translations.literal: Now Your Majesty's merit exceeds the hundred kings, virtue without equal, abundant achievement and great plan, towering enterprise— truly not what we subjects can exhaust in discussion.
translations.idiomatic: Now Your Majesty's merit exceeds the hundred kings, virtue without equal, abundant achievement and great plan, towering enterprise—truly not what we subjects can exhaust in discussion.

sentences.zh: 而聖旨勞謙，屢自抑損，時至弗應，推美不居，闕皇代之上儀，塞神祇之款望，使大晉之典謨，不同風於三、五。

translations.literal: Yet the sage intent is laboring and modest, repeatedly self-restraining; the time arrives yet not responding, pushing beauty not occupying— lacking the august dynasty's upper ritual, blocking the spirits' sincere hope, making Great Jin's canons and plans not share wind with the Three and Five.
translations.idiomatic: Yet the sage intent is laboring and modest, repeatedly self-restraining; the time arrives yet not responding, pushing beauty not occupying—lacking the august dynasty's upper ritual, blocking the spirits' sincere hope, making Great Jin's canons not share wind with the Three and Five.

sentences.zh: 臣等誠不敢奉詔，請如前奏施行。

translations.literal: We subjects truly dare not receive the edict; please as in the former memorial implement.
translations.idiomatic: We subjects truly dare not receive the edict; please as in the former memorial implement.

sentences.zh: 」詔曰：「方當共弘治道，以康庶績。

translations.literal: Edict: "Just now we should together exalt governing the Way, to bring peace to the myriad achievements.
translations.idiomatic: The edict replied: "Just now we should together exalt governing the Way to bring peace to the myriad achievements.

sentences.zh: 且俟他年，無復紛紜也。」

translations.literal: And await other years; no further confusion."
translations.idiomatic: And await other years; no further confusion."

sentences.zh: 太康元年冬，王公有司又奏：「自古聖明，光宅四海，封禪名山，著於史籍，作者七十四君矣。

translations.literal: Taikang year one winter, princes and responsible officials again memorialized: "From ancient sage brilliance, illuminating and dwelling in the four seas, enfeoffing famous mountains— recorded in histories and annals, authors seventy-four rulers.
translations.idiomatic: In the winter of Taikang 1, princes and responsible officials memorialized again: "From ancient sage brilliance illuminating the four seas, enfeoffing famous mountains—recorded in histories and annals, seventy-four rulers have done so.

sentences.zh: 舜、禹之有天下，巡狩四嶽，躬行其道。

translations.literal: Shun and Yu having the realm— inspection tours of the four peaks, personally performing their Way.
translations.idiomatic: Shun and Yu having the realm—inspection tours of the four peaks, personally performing their Way.

sentences.zh: 易著『觀民省方』，禮有『升中于天』，詩頌『陟其高山』，皆載在方策。

translations.literal: Changes shows 'Observing the people and examining directions,' Rites has 'Ascending to the center of Heaven,' Odes praise 'Ascending its high mountain'— all recorded in registers and plans.
translations.idiomatic: The Changes shows 'Observing the people and examining directions,' the Rites has 'Ascending to the center of Heaven,' the Odes praise 'Ascending its high mountain'—all recorded in registers and plans.

sentences.zh: 文王為西伯，以服事殷，周公以魯蕃，列于諸侯，或享于岐山，或有事泰山。

translations.literal: King Wen as Western Earl served Yin; Duke of Zhou with Lu as feudatory ranked among feudal lords— some feasted at Mount Qi, some had affairs at Mount Tai.
translations.idiomatic: King Wen as Western Earl served Yin; the Duke of Zhou with Lu as feudatory ranked among feudal lords—some feasted at Mount Qi, some had affairs at Mount Tai.

sentences.zh: 徒以聖德，猶得為其事。

translations.literal: Only because of sage virtue could they still perform the affair.
translations.idiomatic: Only by virtue of sage merit could they perform the rite at all.

sentences.zh: 自是以來，功薄而僭其儀者，不可勝言，號諡不泯，以至于今。

translations.literal: From then onward, merit thin yet usurping its ritual— cannot be fully stated; titles and posthumous names not extinguished, down to the present.
translations.idiomatic: From then onward, merit thin yet usurping its ritual—cannot be fully stated; titles and posthumous names not extinguished, down to the present.

sentences.zh: 況高祖宣皇帝肇開王業，海外有截；

translations.literal: Moreover High Ancestor Emperor Xuan at the beginning opened royal enterprise, overseas cut off;
translations.idiomatic: Moreover High Ancestor Emperor Xuan at the beginning opened royal enterprise and cut off overseas;

sentences.zh: 世宗景皇帝濟以大功，輯寧區夏；

translations.literal: World Ancestor Emperor Jing aided with great achievement, gathering peace in the regions of Xia;
translations.idiomatic: World Ancestor Emperor Jing aided with great achievement, gathering peace in the regions of Xia;

sentences.zh: 太祖文皇帝受命造晉，蕩定蜀漢；

translations.literal: Grand Ancestor Emperor Wen received mandate creating Jin, sweeping and settling Shu and Han;
translations.idiomatic: Grand Ancestor Emperor Wen received mandate creating Jin, sweeping and settling Shu and Han;

sentences.zh: 陛下應期龍興，混壹六合，澤被羣生，威震無外。

translations.literal: Your Majesty responded to the term and dragon rose, unifying the six directions, grace covering all living beings, awe shaking beyond the borders.
translations.idiomatic: Your Majesty responded to the term and dragon rose, unifying the six directions, grace covering all living beings, awe shaking beyond the borders.

sentences.zh: 昔漢氏失統，吳、蜀鼎峙，兵興以來，近將百年。

translations.literal: Formerly Han lost succession, Wu and Shu stood like tripods, warfare since near approaching a hundred years.
translations.idiomatic: Formerly Han lost succession, Wu and Shu stood like tripods; warfare since has approached a hundred years.

sentences.zh: 地險俗殊，民望絕塞，以為分外，其日久矣。

translations.literal: Terrain dangerous, customs different, people's hope severed by barriers— considered outside the realm, this has been long.
translations.idiomatic: Terrain dangerous, customs different, people's hope severed by barriers—considered outside the realm, this has been long.

sentences.zh: 大業之隆，重光四葉，不覊之寇，二世而平。

translations.literal: Great enterprise's splendor, heavy light four generations, unrestrained bandits— two generations and pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Great enterprise's splendor, heavy light four generations; unrestrained bandits—two generations and pacified.

sentences.zh: 非聰明神武，先天弗違，孰能巍巍其有成功若茲者歟！

translations.literal: If not intelligent, divine, and martial, beforehand not opposing Heaven— who could tower and have success like this!
translations.idiomatic: If not intelligent, divine, and martial, beforehand not opposing Heaven—who could tower and have success like this!

sentences.zh: 臣等幸以千載，得遭運會，親奉大化，目覩太平，至公之美，誰與為讓。

translations.literal: We subjects fortunate in this thousand-year age to encounter the fortune, personally receiving great transformation, eye witnessing peace— utmost public beauty, with whom to decline.
translations.idiomatic: We subjects are fortunate in this thousand-year age to encounter the fortune, personally receiving great transformation, eye witnessing peace—utmost public beauty, with whom to decline.

sentences.zh: 宜祖述先朝，憲章古昔，勒功岱嶽，登封告成，弘禮樂之制，正三雍之典，揚名萬世，以顯祖宗。

translations.literal: It is suitable to trace ancestors following former courts, take statutes from antiquity, inscribe achievement at Mount Dai, ascend and enfeoff announcing completion, exalt ritual and music's system, correct the three Yong canon, spread name ten thousand generations, to display ancestors.
translations.idiomatic: It is suitable to trace ancestors following former courts, take statutes from antiquity, inscribe achievement at Mount Dai, ascend and enfeoff announcing completion, exalt ritual and music's system, correct the three Yong canon, spread name ten thousand generations, to display ancestors.

sentences.zh: 是以不勝大願，敢昧死以聞。

translations.literal: Thus unable to bear the great wish, daring obscured death to report.
translations.idiomatic: Thus unable to bear the great wish, I dare report obscured by death.

sentences.zh: 請告太常具禮儀。

translations.literal: Please announce to the Minister of Ceremonies to prepare ritual protocol.
translations.idiomatic: Please announce to the Minister of Ceremonies to prepare ritual protocol.

sentences.zh: 」上復詔曰：「所議誠前烈之盛事也。

translations.literal: The emperor again edicted: "What is deliberated is truly the former blazing age's splendid affair.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor again edicted: "What is deliberated is truly the former blazing age's splendid affair.

sentences.zh: 方今未可以爾。

translations.literal: Just now it cannot yet be so.
translations.idiomatic: Just now it cannot yet be so.

sentences.zh: 便報絕之。」

translations.literal: Then report and cut it off."
translations.idiomatic: Then report and cut it off."

sentences.zh: 宋太祖在位長久，有意封禪。

translations.literal: Song Grand Ancestor was on the throne long and had intent for feng and shan.
translations.idiomatic: Song Grand Ancestor was on the throne long and had intent for feng and shan.

sentences.zh: 遣使履行泰山舊道，詔學士山謙之草封禪儀注。

translations.literal: Sent envoys to inspect the old Mount Tai route; edicted Academician Shan Qianzhi to draft feng and shan protocol annotations.
translations.idiomatic: He sent envoys to inspect the old Mount Tai route and edicted Academician Shan Qianzhi to draft feng and shan protocol annotations.

sentences.zh: 其後索虜南寇，六州荒毀，其意乃息。

translations.literal: Afterward the northern bandits invaded south, six provinces ruined and destroyed— his intent then ceased.
translations.idiomatic: Afterward the northern bandits invaded south and six provinces were ruined and destroyed—his intent then ceased.

sentences.zh: 世祖大明元年十一月戊申，太宰江夏王義恭表曰：「惟皇天崇稱大道，始行揖讓。

translations.literal: Shizu, Daming year one eleventh month wushen, Grand Preceptor Prince Yigong of Jiangxia submitted: "Only August Heaven exalts and calls the Great Way, at first performing yielding and resignation.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of Daming 1, Shizu received a submission from Grand Preceptor Prince Liu Yigong of Jiangxia: "Only August Heaven exalts and calls the Great Way, at first performing yielding and resignation.

sentences.zh: 迄于有晉，雖聿修前緒，而跡淪言廢，蔑記於竹素者，焉可單書。

translations.literal: Down to Jin— though urgently repairing former thread, traces sunk and words abandoned, erased from bamboo and silk— how can one write singly.
translations.idiomatic: Down to Jin—though urgently repairing former thread, traces sunk and words abandoned, erased from bamboo and silk—how can one write singly.

sentences.zh: 紹乾維，建徽號，流風聲，被絲管，自無懷以來，可傳而不朽者，七十有四君。

translations.literal: Continuing Qian, establishing emblem titles, flowing wind and sound, covered by silk and pipes— since Wuhuai, what can be transmitted and not decay— seventy-four rulers.
translations.idiomatic: Continuing Qian, establishing emblem titles, flowing wind and sound, covered by silk and pipes—since Wuhuai, what can be transmitted and not decay—seventy-four rulers.

sentences.zh: 罔仁厚而道滅，鮮義澆而德宣，鍾律之先，曠世綿絕，難得而聞。

translations.literal: None benevolent and thick yet Way extinguished; few righteous yet decadent and virtue proclaimed— bell and pitch's precedence, ages distant and thread broken, hard to obtain and hear.
translations.idiomatic: None benevolent and thick yet Way extinguished; few righteous yet decadent and virtue proclaimed—bell and pitch's precedence, ages distant and thread broken, hard to obtain and hear.

sentences.zh: 丘、索著明者，尚有遺炳。

translations.literal: What Qiu and Suo make clear— still has remaining brilliance.
translations.idiomatic: What Qiu and Suo make clear—still has remaining brilliance.

sentences.zh: 故易稱先天弗違，後天奉時。

translations.literal: Thus Changes says beforehand Heaven not opposing, afterward Heaven following seasons.
translations.idiomatic: Thus the Changes says beforehand Heaven not opposing, afterward Heaven following seasons.

sentences.zh: 蓋陶唐姚姒商姬之主，莫不由斯道也。

translations.literal: Probably Tang Yao, Yao's consort, Shang Ji, Zhou Ji rulers— none failed to follow this Way.
translations.idiomatic: Probably Tang Yao, Yao's consort, Shang Ji, and Zhou Ji rulers—none failed to follow this Way.

sentences.zh: 是以風化大洽，光熙于後。

translations.literal: Thus transformation greatly harmonized, brilliance shining afterward.
translations.idiomatic: Thus transformation greatly harmonized and brilliance shone afterward.

sentences.zh: 炎漢二帝，亦踵曩則，因百姓之心，聽輿人之頌，龍駕帝服，鏤玉梁甫，昌言明稱，告成上靈。

translations.literal: Blazing Han two emperors also followed former rule, following the hundred surnames' hearts, hearing the cart men's praise— dragon carriage and imperial robes, carving jade at Liangfu, bright words and clear titles, announcing completion to the upper spirit.
translations.idiomatic: Blazing Han's two emperors also followed former rule, following the people's hearts and hearing the cart men's praise—dragon carriage and imperial robes, carving jade at Liangfu, bright words and clear titles, announcing completion to the upper spirit.

sentences.zh: 況大宋表祥唐虞，受終素德，山龍啟符，金玉顯瑞，異采騰於軫墟，紫煙藹於邦甸，錫冕兆九五之徵，文豹赴天曆之會。

translations.literal: Moreover Great Song displays auspicious signs of Tang and Yu, receiving termination of plain virtue— mountain dragon opening tally, gold and jade displaying omens, strange colors soaring from Zhen ruins, purple mist misty over the domain, bestowed crown signaling the ninety-five sign, patterned leopard attending Heaven's calendar meeting.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover Great Song displays auspicious signs of Tang and Yu, receiving termination of plain virtue—mountain dragon opening tally, gold and jade displaying omens, strange colors soaring from Zhen ruins, purple mist over the domain, bestowed crown signaling the ninety-five sign, patterned leopard attending Heaven's calendar meeting.

sentences.zh: 誠二祖之幽慶，聖后之冥休。

translations.literal: Truly the two ancestors' hidden celebration, the sage empress's dark blessing.
translations.idiomatic: Truly the two ancestors' hidden celebration and the sage empress's dark blessing.

sentences.zh: 道冠軒、堯，惠深亭毒；

translations.literal: Way crowns Xuan and Yao, grace deep as universal nurture;
translations.idiomatic: Way crowns Xuan and Yao, grace deep as universal nurture;

sentences.zh: 而猶執沖約，未言封禪之事，四海竊以恧焉。

translations.literal: yet still holding restrained simplicity, not yet speaking of feng and shan affair— the four seas privately feel ashamed.
translations.idiomatic: yet still holding restrained simplicity, not yet speaking of feng and shan—the four seas privately feel ashamed.

sentences.zh: 臣聞惟皇配極，惟帝祀天，故能上稽乾式，照臨黔首，協和穹昊，膺茲多福。

translations.literal: Your subject hears: only the sovereign matches the pole, only the emperor sacrifices to Heaven— thus able above to examine Qian's pattern, shine upon the black-haired people, harmonize the vaulted blue, receive this abundant blessing.
translations.idiomatic: Your subject hears: only the sovereign matches the pole, only the emperor sacrifices to Heaven—thus able above to examine Qian's pattern, shine upon the people, harmonize the vaulted blue, and receive abundant blessing.

sentences.zh: 高祖武皇帝明並日月，光振八區，拯已溺之晉，濟橫流之世，撥亂寧民，應天受命，鴻徽洽于海表，威稜震乎沙外。

translations.literal: Grand Ancestor Emperor Wu, brilliance joining sun and moon, light shaking the eight regions, saving drowned Jin, crossing the age of drifting currents, settling disorder and bringing peace to the people, responding to Heaven receiving mandate— great emblem harmonizing beyond the seas, aweing majesty shaking beyond the sands.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Ancestor Emperor Wu, brilliance joining sun and moon, light shaking the eight regions, saving drowned Jin, crossing the age of drifting currents, settling disorder and bringing peace to the people, responding to Heaven receiving mandate—great emblem harmonizing beyond the seas, aweing majesty shaking beyond the sands.

sentences.zh: 太祖文皇帝體聖履仁，述業興禮，正樂頌，作象曆，明達通於神祇，玄澤被乎上下。

translations.literal: Grand Ancestor Emperor Wen embodied sagehood and tread benevolence, continuing enterprise and raising ritual, correcting music and praise, making elephant calendar— clarity reaching through to spirits and earthly powers, mysterious grace covering above and below.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Ancestor Emperor Wen embodied sagehood and tread benevolence, continuing enterprise and raising ritual, correcting music and praise, making elephant calendar—clarity reaching through to spirits and earthly powers, mysterious grace covering above and below.

sentences.zh: 仁孝命世，叡武英挺，遭運屯否，三才湮滅，迺龍飛五洲，鳳翔九江，身先八百之期，斷出人鬼之表，慶煙應高牙之建，風耀符發迹之辰，親翦凶逆，躬清昏壒，天地革始，夫婦更造，豈與彼承業繼緒，拓復禹跡，車一其軌，書罔異文者，同年而議哉！
