translations.literal: Now writing and tracks not yet one— may stop this memorial."
translations.idiomatic: Now writing and tracks not yet one—may stop this memorial."

sentences.zh: 漢獻帝建安十八年五月，以河北十郡封魏武帝為魏公。

translations.literal: Han Emperor Xian Jian'an year eighteen fifth month, with ten commanderies of Hebei enfeoffed Wei Emperor Wu as Duke of Wei.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of Jian'an 18, Han Emperor Xian enfeoffed Wei Emperor Wu as Duke of Wei with ten commanderies of Hebei.

sentences.zh: 是年七月，始建宗廟于鄴，自以諸侯禮立五廟也。

translations.literal: That year seventh month, first established ancestral temple at Ye, personally using feudal lords' ritual to establish five temples.
translations.idiomatic: That seventh month the ancestral temple was first established at Ye, using feudal lords' ritual to establish five temples.

sentences.zh: 後雖進爵為王，無所改易。

translations.literal: Afterward though advancing rank to king, nothing was changed.
translations.idiomatic: Afterward, though his rank advanced to king, nothing was changed.

sentences.zh: 延康元年，文帝繼王位，七月，追尊皇祖為太王，丁夫人曰太王后。

translations.literal: Yankang year one, Emperor Wen succeeded the royal position; seventh month, posthumously honored imperial grandfather as Grand King, Lady Ding as Grand Queen.
translations.idiomatic: In Yankang 1, Emperor Wen succeeded the royal position; in the seventh month he posthumously honored his imperial grandfather as Grand King and Lady Ding as Grand Queen.

sentences.zh: 黃初元年十一月受禪，又追尊太王曰太皇帝，皇考武王曰武皇帝。

translations.literal: Huangchu year one eleventh month receiving abdication, again posthumously honored Grand King as Grand Emperor, imperial father King Wu as Emperor Wu.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of Huangchu 1, receiving the abdication, he again posthumously honored Grand King as Grand Emperor and his imperial father King Wu as Emperor Wu.

sentences.zh: 明帝太和三年六月，又追尊高祖大長秋曰高皇，夫人吳氏曰高皇后，並在鄴廟廟所祠。

translations.literal: Emperor Ming Taihe year three sixth month, again posthumously honored High Ancestor Grand Autumn as High Emperor, Lady Wu as High Empress— both at Ye temple's temple worship.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of Taihe 3, Emperor Ming again posthumously honored High Ancestor Grand Autumn as High Emperor and Lady Wu as High Empress—both worshipped at the Ye temple.

sentences.zh: 則文帝之高祖處士、曾祖高皇、祖太皇帝共一廟。

translations.literal: Then Emperor Wen's great-grandfather commoner, great-grandfather High Emperor, and grandfather Grand Emperor shared one temple.
translations.idiomatic: Then Emperor Wen's great-grandfather the commoner, great-grandfather High Emperor, and grandfather Grand Emperor shared one temple.

sentences.zh: 考太祖武皇帝特一廟百世不毀，然則所祠止於親廟四室也。

translations.literal: Imperial father Grand Ancestor Emperor Wu had a special temple never destroyed through a hundred generations— thus what was worshipped stopped at four chambers of the immediate temple.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial father Grand Ancestor Emperor Wu had a special temple never destroyed through a hundred generations—thus worship stopped at four chambers of the immediate temple.

sentences.zh: 至明帝太和三年十一月，洛京廟成，則以親盡遷處士主，置園邑，使令丞奉薦。

translations.literal: To Emperor Ming Taihe year three eleventh month, Luoyang capital temple completed— then with affection exhausted moved commoner tablet, established garden settlement, sent magistrate and assistant to offer sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: By the eleventh month of Taihe 3, the Luoyang capital temple was completed—then with affection exhausted the commoner tablet was moved, a garden settlement established, and a magistrate and assistant sent to offer sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 而使行太傅太常韓暨、行太廟宗正曹恪持節迎高皇以下神主共一廟，猶為四室而已。

translations.literal: And sent Acting Grand Tutor Minister of Ceremonies Han Ji, Acting Grand Temple Director of Imperial Clan Cao Ke with staff to welcome High Emperor and below spirit tablets together in one temple— still only four chambers.
translations.idiomatic: Acting Grand Tutor Minister of Ceremonies Han Ji and Acting Grand Temple Director of Imperial Clan Cao Ke were sent with staff to welcome High Emperor and below spirit tablets together in one temple—still only four chambers.

sentences.zh: 至景初元年六月，羣公有司始更奏定七廟之制，曰：「大魏三聖相承，以成帝業。

translations.literal: To Jingchu year one sixth month, ministers and responsible officials first again memorialized fixing the seven-temple system: "Great Wei three sages succeeded one another, thereby completing imperial enterprise.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of Jingchu 1, ministers and responsible officials first memorialized fixing the seven-temple system: "Great Wei three sages succeeded one another, thereby completing imperial enterprise.

sentences.zh: 武皇帝肇建洪基，撥亂夷險，為魏太祖。

translations.literal: Emperor Wu at the beginning established great foundation, settling disorder and leveling danger— is Wei Grand Ancestor.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Wu at the beginning established great foundation, settling disorder and leveling danger—is Wei Grand Ancestor.

sentences.zh: 文皇帝繼天革命，應期受禪，為魏高祖。

translations.literal: Emperor Wen succeeding Heaven's revolution, responding to the term receiving abdication— is Wei High Ancestor.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Wen succeeding Heaven's revolution, responding to the term receiving abdication—is Wei High Ancestor.

sentences.zh: 上集成大命，清定華夏，興制禮樂，宜為魏烈祖。

translations.literal: Your Majesty completing great mandate, clearing and settling Huaxia, raising and establishing ritual and music— should be Wei Blazing Ancestor.
translations.idiomatic: Your Majesty completing great mandate, clearing and settling Huaxia, raising and establishing ritual and music—should be Wei Blazing Ancestor.

sentences.zh: 」更於太祖廟北為二祧，其左為文帝廟，號曰高祖，昭祧，其右擬明帝號曰烈祖，穆祧。

translations.literal: Further north of Grand Ancestor temple made two zhao; its left is Emperor Wen's temple, titled High Ancestor, bright zhao; its right plans Emperor Ming titled Blazing Ancestor, reverent zhao.
translations.idiomatic: North of the Grand Ancestor temple two zhao were made: on the left Emperor Wen's temple, titled High Ancestor, bright zhao; on the right Emperor Ming was planned as Blazing Ancestor, reverent zhao.

sentences.zh: 三祖之廟，萬世不毀，其餘四廟，親盡迭遷，一如周后稷、文、武廟祧之禮。

translations.literal: Three ancestors' temples, ten thousand generations not destroyed; the remaining four temples, affection exhausted in turn moved— all like Zhou's Hou Ji, Wen, Wu temple zhao ritual.
translations.idiomatic: Three ancestors' temples, ten thousand generations not destroyed; the remaining four temples, affection exhausted in turn moved—all like Zhou's Hou Ji, Wen, Wu temple zhao ritual.

sentences.zh: 孫盛魏氏春秋曰：「夫諡以表行，廟以存容，皆於既歿然後著焉。

translations.literal: Sun Sheng's Wei Clan Spring and Autumn says: "Posthumous names express conduct, temples preserve countenance— all after death then displayed.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Sheng's Wei Clan Spring and Autumn says: "Posthumous names express conduct, temples preserve countenance—all after death then displayed.

sentences.zh: 所以原始要終，以示百世者也。

translations.literal: Thus seeking origin and requiring end, to show a hundred generations.
translations.idiomatic: Thus seeking origin and requiring end, to display meaning for a hundred generations.

sentences.zh: 未有當年而逆制祖宗，未終而豫自尊顯。

translations.literal: Never has there been in the same year reversing system for ancestors and temples, not ended yet presumptuously self-exalting.
translations.idiomatic: Never before has the system for ancestors and temples been reversed in the same year, before death yet presumptuously self-exalting.

sentences.zh: 昔華樂以厚歛致譏，周人以豫凶違禮，魏之羣司，於是乎失正矣。」

translations.literal: Formerly Hua Yue because of heavy levies received criticism; Zhou people because of anticipating misfortune violated ritual— Wei's various offices, at this lost correctness."
translations.idiomatic: Formerly Hua Yue because of heavy levies received criticism; Zhou people because of anticipating misfortune violated ritual—Wei's various offices, at this lost correctness."

sentences.zh: 文帝甄后賜死，故不列廟。

translations.literal: Emperor Wen's Empress Zhen was granted death— therefore not ranked in temple.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Wen's Empress Zhen was ordered to die—therefore not ranked in temple.

sentences.zh: 明帝即位，有司奏請追諡曰文昭皇后，使司空王朗持節奉策告祠于陵。

translations.literal: When Emperor Ming ascended, responsible officials memorialized requesting posthumous title Empress Wenzhao, sent Minister of Works Wang Lang with staff presenting edict announcing sacrifice at tomb.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Ming ascended, responsible officials memorialized requesting posthumous title Empress Wenzhao; Minister of Works Wang Lang was sent with staff presenting edict announcing sacrifice at tomb.

sentences.zh: 三公又奏曰：「自古周人始祖后稷，又特立廟以祀姜嫄。

translations.literal: Three Dukes again memorialized: "From ancient times Zhou people ancestral founder Hou Ji, again specially established temple to sacrifice Jiang Yuan.
translations.idiomatic: Three Dukes again memorialized: "From ancient times Zhou people's ancestral founder Hou Ji again had a special temple to sacrifice Jiang Yuan.

sentences.zh: 今文昭皇后之於後嗣，聖德至化，豈有量哉。

translations.literal: Now Empress Wenzhao toward later generations, sage virtue to utmost transformation— how can there be measure?
translations.idiomatic: Now Empress Wenzhao toward later generations, sage virtue to utmost transformation—how can there be measure?

sentences.zh: 夫以皇家世妃之尊，神靈遷化，而無寢廟以承享祀，非以報顯德，昭孝敬也。

translations.literal: Taking the imperial house's generations of consort honor, spirit migrating and transforming, yet without sleeping temple to continue offering sacrifice— not thereby repaying displayed virtue, displaying filial reverence.
translations.idiomatic: Taking the imperial house's generations of consort honor, spirit migrating and transforming, yet without sleeping temple to continue offering sacrifice—not thereby repaying displayed virtue, displaying filial reverence.

sentences.zh: 稽之古制，宜依周禮，先妣別立寢廟。

translations.literal: Examining antiquity's system, it is suitable to follow Rites of Zhou, deceased mother separately establishing sleeping temple.
translations.idiomatic: Examining antiquity's system, it is suitable to follow the Rites of Zhou and separately establish a sleeping temple for the deceased mother.

sentences.zh: 」奏可。

translations.literal: Memorial approved.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial was approved.

sentences.zh: 以太和元年二月，立廟于鄴。

translations.literal: Using Taihe year one second month, established temple at Ye.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of Taihe 1, temple was established at Ye.

sentences.zh: 四月，洛邑初營宗廟，掘地得玉璽方一寸九分，其文曰：「天子羨思慈親。

translations.literal: Fourth month, Luoyang capital first constructing ancestral temple, digging earth obtained jade seal one inch square nine tenths, its text: "Son of Heaven admires thinking kindly parent."
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, as Luoyang's ancestral temple was first constructed, digging earth yielded a jade seal one inch and nine tenths square, inscribed: "The Son of Heaven admires and thinks kindly of his parent."

sentences.zh: 」明帝為之改容。

translations.literal: Emperor Ming for this changed countenance.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Ming's expression changed at this.

sentences.zh: 以太牢告廟。

translations.literal: With great victim announced to temple.
translations.idiomatic: He announced the event to the temple with a great sacrificial victim.

sentences.zh: 至景初元年十二月己未，有司又奏文昭皇后立廟京師，永傳享祀。

translations.literal: To Jingchu year one twelfth month jiwei, responsible officials again memorialized Empress Wenzhao establish temple capital, forever transmitting feast sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: By jiwei day of the twelfth month in Jingchu 1, responsible officials again memorialized that Empress Wenzhao's temple be established in the capital for perpetual feast sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 樂舞與祖廟同。

translations.literal: Music and dance same as ancestral temple.
translations.idiomatic: Music and dance were the same as at the ancestral temple.

sentences.zh: 廢鄴廟。

translations.literal: Abolished Ye temple.
translations.idiomatic: The Ye temple was abolished.

sentences.zh: 魏文帝黃初二年六月，以洛京宗廟未成，乃祠武帝於建始殿，親執饋奠如家人禮。

translations.literal: Wei Emperor Wen Huangchu year two sixth month, because Luoyang capital ancestral temple not yet completed, then sacrificed to Emperor Wu at Jianshi Hall, personally holding offering and presentation like family ritual.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of Huangchu 2, because Luoyang's ancestral temple was not yet completed, Wei Emperor Wen sacrificed to Emperor Wu at Jianshi Hall, personally holding offering and presentation like family ritual.

sentences.zh: 何承天曰：「案禮，將營宮室，宗廟為先。

translations.literal: He Chengtian says: "Considering ritual, about to construct palace chambers, ancestral temple comes first.
translations.idiomatic: He Chengtian says: "By ritual, when palace chambers are about to be constructed, the ancestral temple comes first.

sentences.zh: 庶人無廟，故祭於寢。

translations.literal: Common people have no temple— therefore sacrifice in sleeping chamber.
translations.idiomatic: Common people have no temple—therefore sacrifice in sleeping chamber.

sentences.zh: 帝者行之，非禮甚矣。」

translations.literal: Emperors performing it— not ritual, very much so."
translations.idiomatic: Emperors performing it—not ritual, very much so."

sentences.zh: 漢獻帝延康元年七月，魏文帝幸譙，親祠譙陵，此漢禮也。

translations.literal: Han Emperor Xian Yankang year one seventh month, Wei Emperor Wen visited Qiao, personally sacrificed at Qiao tomb— this is Han ritual.
translations.idiomatic: Han Emperor Xian Yankang year one seventh month, Wei Emperor Wen visited Qiao, personally sacrificed at Qiao tomb—this is Han ritual.

sentences.zh: 漢氏諸陵皆有園寢者，承秦所為也。

translations.literal: Han house various tombs all have garden sleeping quarters— continuing what Qin established.
translations.idiomatic: Han house various tombs all have garden sleeping quarters—continuing what Qin established.

sentences.zh: 說者以為古前廟後寢，以象人君前有朝後有寢也。

translations.literal: Explainers consider ancient front temple rear sleeping chamber, to symbolize ruler front has court rear has sleeping chamber.
translations.idiomatic: Explainers hold that anciently the temple stood front and sleeping chamber rear, symbolizing the ruler's court in front and sleeping chamber behind.

sentences.zh: 廟以藏主，四時祭祀，寢有衣冠象生之具以薦新。

translations.literal: Temple to store tablets; four seasons sacrifice. Sleeping chamber has garment hat image-life implements to offer new.
translations.idiomatic: The temple stored tablets for four-season sacrifice; the sleeping chamber held garments, hats, and image-life implements for offering new.

sentences.zh: 秦始出寢起於墓側，漢因弗改。

translations.literal: Qin at first removed sleeping chamber starting at tomb side; Han following did not change.
translations.idiomatic: Qin at first moved the sleeping chamber to the tomb side; Han followed without change.

sentences.zh: 陵上稱寢殿，象生之具，古寢之意也。

translations.literal: On tomb called sleeping hall; image-life implements— ancient sleeping chamber's meaning.
translations.idiomatic: On tomb called sleeping hall; image-life implements—ancient sleeping chamber's meaning.

sentences.zh: 及魏武帝葬高陵，有司依漢，立陵上祭殿。

translations.literal: When Wei Emperor Wu buried at Gaoling, responsible officials following Han established tomb-top sacrifice hall.
translations.idiomatic: When Wei Emperor Wu was buried at Gaoling, responsible officials following Han practice established a tomb-top sacrifice hall.

sentences.zh: 至文帝黃初三年，乃詔曰：「先帝躬履節儉，遺詔省約。

translations.literal: To Emperor Wen Huangchu year three, then edicted: "Former emperor personally treading frugal simplicity, testamentary edict economizing.
translations.idiomatic: In Huangchu 3, Emperor Wen edicted: "The former emperor personally practiced frugal simplicity, and his testamentary edict called for economy.

sentences.zh: 子以述父為孝，臣以繫事為忠。

translations.literal: The son continuing the father is filial piety; the subject continuing affairs is loyalty.
translations.idiomatic: For a son to carry on his father's work is filial piety; for a subject to carry on his lord's affairs is loyalty.

sentences.zh: 古不墓祭，皆設於廟。

translations.literal: Ancient times did not sacrifice at tomb— all set at temple.
translations.idiomatic: Ancient times did not sacrifice at tomb—all set at temple.

sentences.zh: 高陵上殿屋皆毀壞，車馬還厩，衣服藏府，以從先帝儉德之志。

translations.literal: Gaoling upper hall chambers all destroyed, horses and chariots returned to stable, garments stored in treasury— to follow former emperor's frugal virtue's will.
translations.idiomatic: Gaoling upper hall chambers all destroyed, horses and chariots returned to stable, garments stored in treasury—to follow former emperor's frugal virtue's will.

sentences.zh: 」及文帝自作終制，又曰：「壽陵無立寢殿，造園邑。

translations.literal: And Emperor Wen himself made final regulations, again said: "Shouling without establishing sleeping hall, making garden settlement."
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Wen's own final regulations again stated: "At Shouling do not establish a sleeping hall; make only a garden settlement."

sentences.zh: 」自後至今，陵寢遂絕。

translations.literal: From afterward until now, tomb sleeping quarters then severed.
translations.idiomatic: From that time to the present, tomb sleeping quarters have been abolished.

sentences.zh: 孫權不立七廟，以父堅嘗為長沙太守，長沙臨湘縣立堅廟而已。

translations.literal: Sun Quan did not establish seven temples; because father Jian once was Changsha Administrator, only established Jian temple at Changsha Linxiang county.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Quan did not establish seven temples; because his father Sun Jian once was Changsha Administrator, only established a Jian temple at Changsha's Linxiang county.

sentences.zh: 權既不親祠，直是依後漢奉南頓故事，使太守祠也。

translations.literal: Since Quan did not personally sacrifice, it was directly following Later Han's offering at Nandun precedent, having the Administrator sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: Since Sun Quan did not sacrifice in person, he simply followed Later Han precedent at Nandun and had the Administrator perform the rite.

sentences.zh: 堅廟又見尊曰始祖廟，而不在京師。

translations.literal: Jian's temple was also honored as Ancestor-Founder Temple, yet not in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Jian's temple was also honored as the Ancestor-Founder Temple, yet it stood outside the capital.

sentences.zh: 又以民人所發吳芮冢材為屋，未之前聞也。

translations.literal: Moreover using timber from the tomb of Wu Rui that the people had opened for the building— never heard of before.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover they used timber from the tomb of Wu Rui that commoners had opened—something unheard of before.

sentences.zh: 於建鄴立兄長沙桓王策廟於朱爵橋南。

translations.literal: At Jianye established elder brother Prince of Changsha Ce's temple south of Zhuque Bridge.
translations.idiomatic: At Jianye they established a temple to his elder brother, Prince of Changsha Sun Ce, south of Zhuque Bridge.

sentences.zh: 權疾，太子所禱，即策廟也。

translations.literal: When Quan fell ill, the crown prince's prayers were at Ce's temple.
translations.idiomatic: When Sun Quan fell ill, the crown prince prayed at Sun Ce's temple.

sentences.zh: 權卒，子亮代立。

translations.literal: Quan died; son Liang succeeded.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Quan died; his son Sun Liang succeeded him.

sentences.zh: 明年正月，於宮東立權廟曰太祖廟，既不在宮南，又無昭穆之序。

translations.literal: Next year first month, east of the palace established Quan's temple called Grand Ancestor Temple— neither south of the palace, nor with bright-reverent ordering.
translations.idiomatic: The next first month they established Sun Quan's temple east of the palace, calling it the Grand Ancestor Temple—neither south of the palace nor in bright-reverent order.

sentences.zh: 及孫晧初立，追尊父和曰文皇帝。

translations.literal: When Sun Hao first ascended, posthumously honored father He as Emperor Wen.
translations.idiomatic: When Sun Hao first ascended, he posthumously honored his father Sun He as Emperor Wen.

sentences.zh: 晧先封烏程侯，即改葬和於烏程西山，號曰明陵，置園邑二百家。

translations.literal: Hao had first been enfeoffed Marquis of Wucheng— immediately changed burial of He at Wucheng Western Mountain, titled Bright Tomb, established garden settlement two hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Hao had first been enfeoffed as Marquis of Wucheng—he immediately reburied Sun He on Wucheng's Western Mountain, titled the tomb Bright Tomb, and established a garden settlement of two hundred households.

sentences.zh: 於烏程立陵寢，使縣令丞四時奉祠。

translations.literal: At Wucheng established tomb sleeping quarters, sent county magistrate and assistant four seasons offering sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: At Wucheng they established tomb sleeping quarters and ordered the county magistrate and assistant to offer sacrifice in all four seasons.

sentences.zh: 寶鼎元年，遂於烏程分置吳興郡，使太守執事。

translations.literal: Baoding year one, then at Wucheng separately established Wuxing commandery, sent Administrator to manage affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In Baoding 1 they separately established Wuxing commandery at Wucheng and sent an Administrator to manage affairs.

sentences.zh: 有司尋又言宜立廟京邑。

translations.literal: Responsible officials soon again said it was suitable to establish temple at capital city.
translations.idiomatic: The responsible officials soon proposed that a temple should be established in the capital.

sentences.zh: 寶鼎二年，遂更營建，號曰清廟。

translations.literal: Baoding year two, then again constructed, titled Clear Temple.
translations.idiomatic: In Baoding 2 they constructed it anew, titling it the Clear Temple.

sentences.zh: 遣守丞相孟仁、太常姚信等備官僚中軍步騎，以靈輿法駕迎神主於明陵，親引仁拜送於庭。

translations.literal: Sent Acting Chancellor Meng Ren, Minister of Ceremonies Yao Xin and others to prepare officials, Central Army infantry and cavalry, with spirit carriage and law chariot to welcome spirit tablet from Bright Tomb; personally led Ren bowing and sending off in court.
translations.idiomatic: They sent Acting Chancellor Meng Ren, Minister of Ceremonies Yao Xin, and others with Central Army infantry and cavalry, using the spirit carriage and law chariot to welcome the spirit tablet from Bright Tomb; Sun Hao personally led Ren in bowing and sending it off in court.

sentences.zh: 比仁還，中吏手詔日夜相繼，奉問神靈起居動止。

translations.literal: When Ren returned, central clerks' hand edicts day and night in succession, offering inquiry into spirits' rising, resting, movement and stopping.
translations.idiomatic: When Ren returned, hand edicts from central clerks followed day and night in succession, inquiring into the spirits' rising, resting, movement, and stopping.

sentences.zh: 巫覡言見和被服顏色如平日，晧悲喜，悉召公卿尚書詣閤下受賜。

translations.literal: Shamans and diviners said they saw He in garments and countenance as on ordinary days— Hao both grieved and rejoiced, all summoned ministers and grandees and Masters of Writing to the pavilion to receive gifts.
translations.idiomatic: Shamans and diviners said they saw Sun He in garments and countenance as on ordinary days—Sun Hao both grieved and rejoiced and summoned all ministers, grandees, and Masters of Writing to the pavilion to receive gifts.

sentences.zh: 靈輿當至，使丞相陸凱奉三牲祭於近郊。

translations.literal: When spirit carriage was about to arrive, sent Chancellor Lu Kai offering three victims sacrifice at near suburbs.
translations.idiomatic: When the spirit carriage was about to arrive, he sent Chancellor Lu Kai to offer a three-victim sacrifice at the near suburbs.

sentences.zh: 晧於金城外露宿。

translations.literal: Hao at Jincheng outside exposed lodging.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Hao lodged exposed outside Jincheng.

sentences.zh: 明日，望拜於東門之外，又拜廟薦饗。

translations.literal: Next day, gazing and bowing outside east gate, again bowing at temple presenting feast.
translations.idiomatic: The next day he gazed and bowed outside the east gate, then again bowed at the temple presenting a feast.

sentences.zh: 比七日，三祭，倡伎晝夜娛樂。

translations.literal: Compared to seven days, three sacrifices, singers and performers day and night entertainment.
translations.idiomatic: For seven days he held three sacrifices, with singers and performers entertaining day and night.

sentences.zh: 有司奏：「『祭不欲數，數則黷』，宜以禮斷情。

translations.literal: Responsible officials memorialized: "'Sacrifice does not wish frequency; frequent then excessive'— it is suitable to cut off feeling by ritual."
translations.idiomatic: The responsible officials memorialized: "'Sacrifice should not be frequent; frequency brings excess'—feeling should be restrained by ritual."

sentences.zh: 」然後止。

translations.literal: Then stopped.
translations.idiomatic: Then the rites stopped.

sentences.zh: 劉備章武元年四月，建尊號於成都。

translations.literal: Liu Bei Zhangwu year one fourth month, established honored title at Chengdu.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of Zhangwu 1, Liu Bei established his honored title at Chengdu.

sentences.zh: 是月，立宗廟，祫祭高祖已下。

translations.literal: That month, established ancestral temple, he sacrifice from High Ancestor down.
translations.idiomatic: That month he established the ancestral temple and performed he sacrifice from the High Ancestor down.

sentences.zh: 備紹世而起，亦未辨繼何帝為禰，亦無祖宗之號。

translations.literal: Bei succeeding the age and rising, also did not distinguish which emperor to succeed as father temple, also had no ancestors' titles.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Bei, succeeding the age and rising, also did not determine which emperor to take as father temple, and had no ancestors' titles.

sentences.zh: 劉禪面縛，北地王諶哭於昭烈之廟，此則備廟別立也。

translations.literal: Liu Shan bound facing north, Northern Palace King Chen wept at Zhaolie's temple— this shows Bei's temple was separately established.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Shan bound facing north, Northern Palace King Liu Chen wept at Liu Bei's temple—showing that Liu Bei's temple was separately established.

sentences.zh: 魏元帝咸熙元年，增封晉文帝進爵為王，追命舞陽宣文侯為晉宣王，忠武侯為晉景王。

translations.literal: Wei Emperor Yuan Xianxi year one, increased enfeoffment of Jin Emperor Wen advancing rank to king, posthumously commanded Wuyang Xuanwen Marquis as Jin Emperor Xuan, Zhongwu Marquis as Jin Emperor Jing.
translations.idiomatic: In Xianxi 1, Wei Emperor Yuan increased Jin Emperor Wen's enfeoffment and advanced his rank to king, posthumously commanding Wuyang Xuanwen Marquis as Jin Emperor Xuan and Zhongwu Marquis as Jin Emperor Jing.

sentences.zh: 是年八月，文帝崩，諡曰文王。

translations.literal: That year eighth month, Emperor Wen died, posthumous title Emperor Wen.
translations.idiomatic: That eighth month Emperor Wen died, receiving the posthumous title Emperor Wen.

sentences.zh: 武帝泰始元年十二月丙寅，受禪。

translations.literal: Emperor Wu Taishi year one twelfth month bingyin, received abdication.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day of the twelfth month in Taishi 1, Emperor Wu received the abdication.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，追尊皇祖宣王為宣皇帝，伯考景王為景皇帝，考文王為文皇帝，宣王妃張氏為宣穆皇后，景王夫人羊氏為景皇后。

translations.literal: Dingmao, posthumously honored imperial grandfather Emperor Xuan as Emperor Xuan, father's elder brother Emperor Jing as Emperor Jing, father Emperor Wen as Emperor Wen; Emperor Xuan's consort Lady Zhang as Empress Xuanmu, Emperor Jing's lady Lady Yang as Empress Jing.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day he posthumously honored his imperial grandfather Emperor Xuan as Emperor Xuan, his father's elder brother Emperor Jing as Emperor Jing, and his father Emperor Wen as Emperor Wen; Emperor Xuan's consort Lady Zhang as Empress Xuanmu and Emperor Jing's lady Lady Yang as Empress Jing.

sentences.zh: 二年正月，有司奏天子七廟，宜如禮營建。

translations.literal: Second year first month, responsible officials memorialized Son of Heaven seven temples— it is suitable to construct according to ritual.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the second year, responsible officials memorialized that the Son of Heaven's seven temples should be constructed according to ritual.

sentences.zh: 帝重其役，詔宜權立一廟。

translations.literal: Emperor weighed the labor, edicted provisionally establishing one temple.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor weighed the labor and edicted provisionally establishing one temple.

sentences.zh: 於是羣臣奏議：「上古清廟一宮，尊遠神祇，逮至周室，制為七廟，以辨宗祧。

translations.literal: Thereupon ministers memorialized deliberation: "Upper antiquity Clear Temple one palace, honoring distant spirits and earthly powers; down to Zhou house, made seven temples to distinguish ancestral lines.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon ministers deliberated: "Upper antiquity's Clear Temple was one palace, honoring distant spirits; down to the Zhou house, seven temples were made to distinguish ancestral lines.

sentences.zh: 聖旨深弘，遠跡上世，敦崇唐、虞。

translations.literal: Sage intent deeply expansive, distant tracks reaching upper ages, thickly honoring Tang and Yu.
translations.idiomatic: The sage intent is deeply expansive, distant tracks reaching upper ages, thickly honoring Tang and Yu.

sentences.zh: 舍七廟之繁華，遵一宮之尊遠。

translations.literal: Setting aside seven temples' splendor, following one palace's honoring the distant.
translations.idiomatic: Setting aside the splendor of seven temples, he followed one palace's honoring of the distant.

sentences.zh: 昔舜承堯禪，受終文祖，遂陟帝位，蓋三十載，月正元日，又格于文祖。

translations.literal: Formerly Shun received Yao's abdication, received termination at Culture Ancestor, then ascended imperial position— probably thirty years; month correct primal day, again arriving at Culture Ancestor.
translations.idiomatic: Formerly Shun received Yao's abdication, received termination at Culture Ancestor, then ascended imperial position—probably thirty years; month correct primal day, again arriving at Culture Ancestor.

sentences.zh: 此則虞氏不改唐廟，因仍舊宮。

translations.literal: This then Yu clan did not change Tang temple, continuing former palace.
translations.idiomatic: Thus the Yu clan did not change the Tang temple, continuing the former palace.

sentences.zh: 可依有虞氏故事，即用魏廟。

translations.literal: May follow Youyu clan precedent, immediately using Wei temple.
translations.idiomatic: May follow the Youyu clan precedent and immediately use the Wei temple.

sentences.zh: 」奏可。

translations.literal: Memorial approved.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial was approved.

sentences.zh: 於是追祭征西將軍、豫章府君、潁川府君、京兆府君，與宣皇帝、景皇帝、文皇帝為三昭三穆。

translations.literal: Thereupon posthumously sacrificed Campaigning West General, Yuzhang Lord, Yingchuan Lord, Jingzhao Lord, with Emperor Xuan, Emperor Jing, Emperor Wen as three bright three reverent.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon they posthumously sacrificed Campaigning West General, Yuzhang Lord, Yingchuan Lord, and Jingzhao Lord with Emperor Xuan, Emperor Jing, and Emperor Wen as three bright and three reverent.

sentences.zh: 是時宣皇未升，太祖虛位，所以祠六世與景帝為七廟，其禮則據王肅說也。

translations.literal: At that time Emperor Xuan not yet ascended, Grand Ancestor position empty— thus worshipped six generations with Emperor Jing as seven temples; ritual then followed Wang Su's explanation.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Emperor Xuan had not yet ascended and the Grand Ancestor position was empty—thus they worshipped six generations with Emperor Jing as seven temples; ritual followed Wang Su's explanation.

sentences.zh: 七月，又詔曰：「主者前奏就魏舊廟，誠亦有準。

translations.literal: Seventh month, again edicted: "Director previously memorialized using Wei old temple— truly also has standard.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month he again edicted: "The Director previously memorialized using the Wei old temple—truly it also has standard.

sentences.zh: 然於祗奉神明，情猶未安。

translations.literal: Yet in reverently serving the spirits, feeling still not at ease.
translations.idiomatic: Yet in reverently serving the spirits, he still felt uneasy.

sentences.zh: 宜更營造，崇正永制。

translations.literal: It is suitable again to construct, exalt correctness and eternal system.
translations.idiomatic: It is suitable again to construct, exalting correctness and eternal system.

sentences.zh: 」於是改創宗廟。

translations.literal: Thereupon altered and created ancestral temple.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon they altered and created the ancestral temple.

sentences.zh: 十一月，追尊景帝夫人夏侯氏為景懷皇后。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, posthumously honored Emperor Jing's lady Lady Xiahou as Empress Jinghuai.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month they posthumously honored Emperor Jing's lady Lady Xiahou as Empress Jinghuai.

sentences.zh: 太康元年，靈壽公主修麗祔于太廟，周、漢未有其準。

translations.literal: Taikang year one, Princess Ling Shou Xiu Li enfeoffed at Grand Temple— Zhou and Han never had this standard.
translations.idiomatic: In Taikang 1, Princess Ling Shou Xiu Li was enfeoffed at the Grand Temple—Zhou and Han never had this standard.

sentences.zh: 魏明帝則別立廟，晉又異魏也。

translations.literal: Emperor Ming of Wei then separately established temple; Jin again differed from Wei.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Ming of Wei then separately established a temple; Jin again differed from Wei.

sentences.zh: 八年，因廟陷當改治。

translations.literal: Eighth year, because temple collapsed should be rebuilt.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year, because the temple collapsed it should be rebuilt.

sentences.zh: 羣臣又議奏曰：「古者七廟異所，自宜如禮。

translations.literal: Ministers again deliberated and memorialized: "Ancient times seven temples different places— naturally it is suitable to follow ritual."
translations.idiomatic: Ministers deliberated and memorialized again: "In ancient times the seven temples stood at different places—naturally it is suitable to follow ritual."

sentences.zh: 」詔又曰：「古雖七廟，自近代以來，皆一廟七室，於禮無廢，於情為敍，亦隨時之宜也。

translations.literal: Edict again: "Ancient though seven temples, from recent generations onward all one temple seven chambers— in ritual not abolished, in feeling as narrative, also following the age's suitability.
translations.idiomatic: The edict replied again: "Anciently there were seven temples, but from recent generations onward all have been one temple with seven chambers—in ritual not abolished, in feeling as narrative, also following the age's suitability.

sentences.zh: 其便仍舊。

translations.literal: Then may continue as before.
translations.idiomatic: They were to continue as before.

sentences.zh: 」至十年，乃更改築於宣陽門內，窮壯極麗。

translations.literal: To tenth year, then again constructed at Xuanyang Gate inside, extremely grand and splendid.
translations.idiomatic: By the tenth year they again constructed it inside Xuanyang Gate, extremely grand and splendid.

sentences.zh: 然坎位之制，猶如初爾。

translations.literal: Yet pit-position system still as at first.
translations.idiomatic: Yet the pit-position system remained as at first.

sentences.zh: 廟成，帝率百官遷神主于新廟，自征西以下，車服導從，皆如帝者之儀。

translations.literal: Temple completed, emperor led hundred officials moving spirit tablets to new temple; from Campaigning West down, chariot garments and escort all like emperors' protocol.
translations.idiomatic: When the temple was completed, the emperor led the hundred officials in moving spirit tablets to the new temple; from Campaigning West down, chariot garments and escort all followed emperors' protocol.

sentences.zh: 摯虞之議也。

translations.literal: Zhi Yu's deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: This followed Zhi Yu's deliberation.

sentences.zh: 至世祖武皇帝崩，則遷征西；

translations.literal: To World Ancestor Emperor Wu dying, then moved Campaigning West;
translations.idiomatic: When World Ancestor Emperor Wu died, Campaigning West was moved;

sentences.zh: 及惠帝崩，又遷豫章。

translations.literal: And when Emperor Hui died, again moved Yuzhang.
translations.idiomatic: and when Emperor Hui died, Yuzhang was moved again.

sentences.zh: 而惠帝世，愍懷太子、太子二子哀太孫臧、沖太孫尚並祔廟。

translations.literal: Yet in Emperor Hui's age, Minhuai crown prince and crown prince's two sons Mourning Grand Heir Zang, Chong Grand Heir Shang all enfeoffed at temple.
translations.idiomatic: Yet in Emperor Hui's age, Minhuai crown prince and the crown prince's two sons Mourning Grand Heir Zang and Chong Grand Heir Shang were all enfeoffed at the temple.

sentences.zh: 元帝世，懷帝殤太子又祔廟，號為陰室四殤。

translations.literal: Emperor Yuan's age, Emperor Huai's infant crown prince again enfeoffed at temple, titled Yin Chamber four infant deaths.
translations.idiomatic: In Emperor Yuan's age, Emperor Huai's infant crown prince was again enfeoffed at the temple, titled Yin Chamber four infant deaths.

sentences.zh: 懷帝初，又策諡武帝楊后曰武悼皇后，改葬峻陽陵側。

translations.literal: At Emperor Huai's beginning, again edicted posthumous title Emperor Wu's Empress Yang as Empress Wudao, changed burial at Junyang tomb side.
translations.idiomatic: At Emperor Huai's beginning, they again edicted posthumous title for Emperor Wu's Empress Yang as Empress Wudao and changed burial beside Junyang tomb.

sentences.zh: 別立弘訓宮，不列於廟。

translations.literal: Separately established Hongxun Palace, not ranked in temple.
translations.idiomatic: They separately established Hongxun Palace, not ranked in the temple.

sentences.zh: 元帝既即尊位，上繼武帝，於禮為禰，如漢光武上繼元帝故事也。

translations.literal: Emperor Yuan having ascended honored position, upward succeeding Emperor Wu— in ritual as father temple, like Han Emperor Guangwu upward succeeding Emperor Yuan precedent.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Yuan having ascended the honored position and upward succeeding Emperor Wu—in ritual as father temple, like Han Emperor Guangwu upward succeeding Emperor Yuan.

sentences.zh: 是時西京神主堙滅虜庭，江左建廟，皆更新造。

translations.literal: At that time Western Capital spirit tablets buried and destroyed in barbarian court; Jiangzuo establishing temple, all newly constructed.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Western Capital spirit tablets were buried and destroyed in the barbarian court; establishing the temple in Jiangzuo, all was newly constructed.

sentences.zh: 尋以登懷帝之主，又遷潁川。

translations.literal: Soon with ascending Emperor Huai's tablet, again moved Yingchuan.
translations.idiomatic: Soon with ascending Emperor Huai's tablet, Yingchuan was moved again.

sentences.zh: 位雖七室，其實五世，蓋從刁協，以兄弟為世數故也。

translations.literal: Position though seven chambers, in substance five generations— probably following Diao Xie, taking brothers as generation count.
translations.idiomatic: Position though seven chambers, in substance five generations—probably following Diao Xie, taking brothers as generation count.

sentences.zh: 于時百度草創，舊禮未備，三祖毀主，權居別室。

translations.literal: At that time hundred offices grass roots creation, old ritual not complete, three ancestors' destroyed tablets, provisionally occupying separate chambers.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the hundred offices were at grass roots creation and old ritual was not complete; three ancestors' destroyed tablets provisionally occupied separate chambers.

sentences.zh: 太興三年，將登愍帝之主，於是乃定更制，還復豫章、潁川二主于昭穆之位，以同惠帝嗣武帝故事，而惠、懷、愍三帝自從春秋尊尊之義，在廟不替也。

translations.literal: Taixing year three, about to ascend Emperor Min's tablet— thereupon fixed altered system, returning Yuzhang and Yingchuan two lords to bright-reverent positions, same as Emperor Hui succeeding Emperor Wu precedent, while Emperors Hui, Huai, and Min from spring-autumn honoring-the-honored meaning, in temple not replaced.
translations.idiomatic: In Taixing 3, about to ascend Emperor Min's tablet—they fixed the altered system, returning Yuzhang and Yingchuan two lords to bright-reverent positions, same as Emperor Hui succeeding Emperor Wu, while Emperors Hui, Huai, and Min from spring-autumn honoring-the-honored meaning were in temple not replaced.

sentences.zh: 至元帝崩，則豫章復遷。

translations.literal: To Emperor Yuan dying, then Yuzhang again moved.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Yuan died, Yuzhang was moved again.

sentences.zh: 然元帝神位，猶在愍帝之下，故有坎室者十也。

translations.literal: Yet Emperor Yuan's spirit position still below Emperor Min's— therefore there were pit chambers totaling ten.
translations.idiomatic: Yet Emperor Yuan's spirit position still stood below Emperor Min's—therefore there were pit chambers totaling ten.

sentences.zh: 至明帝崩，而潁川又遷，猶十室也。

translations.literal: To Emperor Ming dying, and Yingchuan again moved, still ten chambers.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Ming died, Yingchuan was moved again—still ten chambers.

sentences.zh: 于時續廣太廟，故三遷主並還西儲，名之曰祧，以準遠廟。

translations.literal: At that time continuing and expanding Grand Temple— thus three moved lords all returned to western store, named zhao, to standardize distant temple.
translations.idiomatic: At that time continuing and expanding the Grand Temple—thus three moved lords all returned to western store, named zhao, to standardize distant temple.

sentences.zh: 成帝咸和三年，蘇峻覆亂京都，溫嶠等入伐，立行廟於白石，告先帝先后曰：「逆臣蘇峻，傾覆社稷，毀棄三正，汙辱海內。

translations.literal: Emperor Cheng Xianhe year three, Su Jun overturned disorder in capital, Wen Jiao and others entered to attack, established traveling temple at Baishi, announcing to former emperors and empresses: "Rebel minister Su Jun, overturning and destroying state altars, destroying and abandoning three correct, defiling and humiliating within the seas.
translations.idiomatic: In Xianhe 3 under Emperor Cheng, Su Jun overturned order in the capital; Wen Jiao and others entered to attack and established a traveling temple at Baishi, announcing to former emperors and empresses: "Rebel minister Su Jun has overturned the state altars, destroyed the three correct, and defiled the realm.

sentences.zh: 臣亮等手刃戎首，龔行天罰。

translations.literal: Your subjects Liang and others personally bladed the barbarian chiefs, reverently performing Heaven's punishment.
translations.idiomatic: We your subjects Liang and others have personally slain the barbarian chiefs, reverently performing Heaven's punishment.

sentences.zh: 惟中宗元皇帝、肅祖明皇帝、明穆皇后之靈，降鑒有罪，剿絕其命，翦此羣兇，以安宗廟。

translations.literal: Only Middle Ancestor Emperor Yuan, Reverent Ancestor Emperor Ming, Empress Mingmu's spirits— descend to inspect the guilty, exterminate their mandate, cut off these villains, to secure the ancestral temple.
translations.idiomatic: Only Middle Ancestor Emperor Yuan, Reverent Ancestor Emperor Ming, and Empress Mingmu's spirits—descend to inspect the guilty, exterminate their mandate, cut off these villains, to secure the ancestral temple.

sentences.zh: 臣等雖隕首摧軀，猶生之年。

translations.literal: Your subjects though falling heads and crushing bodies, still years of life.
translations.idiomatic: Your subjects though falling heads and crushing bodies, still have years of life.

sentences.zh: 」咸康七年五月，始作武悼皇后神主，祔于廟，配饗世祖。

translations.literal: Xiankang year seven fifth month, first made Empress Wudao spirit tablet, enfeoffed at temple, collateral feast World Ancestor.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of Xiankang 7, they first made Empress Wudao's spirit tablet, enfeoffed at temple, collateral feast with World Ancestor.

sentences.zh: 成帝崩而康帝承統，以兄弟一世，故不遷京兆，始十一室也。

translations.literal: Emperor Cheng died and Emperor Kang succeeded— as brothers one generation, thus not moving Jingzhao; first eleven chambers.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Cheng died and Emperor Kang succeeded—as brothers one generation, Jingzhao was not moved; first eleven chambers.

sentences.zh: 康帝崩，京兆遷入西儲，同謂之祧，如前三祖遷主之禮。

translations.literal: Emperor Kang died, Jingzhao moved into western store, together called zhao, like former three ancestors moved lords' ritual.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Kang died, Jingzhao moved into western store, together called zhao, like former three ancestors moved lords' ritual.

sentences.zh: 故正室猶十一也。

translations.literal: Thus main chambers still eleven.
translations.idiomatic: Thus the main chambers still numbered eleven.

sentences.zh: 穆帝崩而哀帝、海西並為兄弟，無所登降。

translations.literal: Emperor Mu died and Emperors Ai and Haixi both as brothers, nothing to ascend or descend.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Mu died and Emperors Ai and Haixi were both brothers, with nothing to ascend or descend.

sentences.zh: 咸安之初，簡文皇帝上繼元皇帝，世秩登進。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Xi'an, Emperor Jianwen upward succeeded Emperor Yuan, generation ranks ascending.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Xi'an reign, Emperor Jianwen succeeded Emperor Yuan upward, and generation ranks ascended.

sentences.zh: 於是潁川、京兆二主，復還昭穆之位。

translations.literal: Thereupon Yingchuan and Jingzhao two lords, again returned to bright-reverent positions.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon Yingchuan and Jingzhao two lords again returned to bright-reverent positions.

sentences.zh: 至簡文崩，潁川又遷。

translations.literal: To Emperor Jianwen dying, Yingchuan again moved.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Jianwen died, Yingchuan was moved again.

sentences.zh: 孝武皇帝太元十六年，改作太廟，殿正室十六間，東西儲各一間，合十八間。

translations.literal: Emperor Xiaowu Taiyuan year sixteen, altered and constructed Grand Temple— hall main chambers sixteen bays, east and west stores each one bay, total eighteen bays.
translations.idiomatic: In Taiyuan 16, Emperor Xiaowu altered and constructed the Grand Temple—hall main chambers sixteen bays, east and west stores each one bay, total eighteen bays.

sentences.zh: 棟高八丈四尺，堂基長三十九丈一尺，廣十丈一尺。

translations.literal: Ridge height eight zhang four chi, hall foundation length thirty-nine zhang one chi, width ten zhang one chi.
translations.idiomatic: The ridge stood eight zhang four chi high; the hall foundation measured thirty-nine zhang one chi long and ten zhang one chi wide.

sentences.zh: 堂集方石，庭以塼。

translations.literal: Hall gathered square stone, courtyard with brick.
translations.idiomatic: The hall gathered square stone; the courtyard was paved with brick.

sentences.zh: 尊備法駕，遷神主于行廟。

translations.literal: Honoring complete law chariot, moving spirit tablets to traveling temple.
translations.idiomatic: Honoring with complete law chariot, they moved spirit tablets to the traveling temple.

sentences.zh: 征西至京兆四主，及太子太孫，各用其位之儀服。

translations.literal: Campaigning West to Jingzhao four lords, and crown prince grand heir, each using their position's protocol garments.
translations.idiomatic: Campaigning West to Jingzhao four lords, and crown prince grand heir, each used their position's protocol garments.

sentences.zh: 四主不從帝者之儀，是與太康異也。

translations.literal: Four lords not following emperors' protocol— this differs from Taikang.
translations.idiomatic: The four lords did not follow emperors' protocol—this differs from Taikang.

sentences.zh: 諸主既入廟，設脯醢之奠。

translations.literal: Various lords having entered temple, set dried and pickled meat offerings.
translations.idiomatic: When the various lords had entered the temple, dried and pickled meat offerings were set.

sentences.zh: 及新廟成，帝主還室，又設脯醢之奠。

translations.literal: And new temple completed, emperor lords returned to chambers, again set dried and pickled meat offerings.
translations.idiomatic: When the new temple was completed and the emperor lords returned to chambers, dried and pickled meat offerings were set again.

sentences.zh: 十九年二月，追尊簡文母會稽太妃鄭氏為簡文皇帝宣太后，立廟太廟道西。

translations.literal: Nineteenth year second month, posthumously honored Jianwen's mother Kuaiji Grand Consort Lady Zheng as Jianwen Emperor's Empress Dowager Xuan, established temple west of Grand Temple road.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the nineteenth year, they posthumously honored Jianwen's mother Kuaiji Grand Consort Lady Zheng as Jianwen Emperor's Empress Dowager Xuan and established a temple west of the Grand Temple road.

sentences.zh: 及孝武崩，京兆又遷，如穆帝之世四祧故事。

translations.literal: And Emperor Xiaowu dying, Jingzhao again moved, like Emperor Mu's age four zhao precedent.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Xiaowu died, Jingzhao was moved again, like Emperor Mu's age four zhao precedent.

sentences.zh: 安帝隆安四年，以孝武母簡文李太后、帝母宣德陳太后祔于宣鄭太后之廟。

translations.literal: Emperor An Longan year four, enfeoffed Xiaowu's mother Jianwen Empress Dowager Li and emperor's mother Xunde Empress Dowager Chen at Empress Dowager Xuan Zheng's temple.
translations.idiomatic: In Longan 4 under Emperor An, they enfeoffed Xiaowu's mother Jianwen Empress Dowager Li and the emperor's mother Xunde Empress Dowager Chen at Empress Dowager Xuan Zheng's temple.

sentences.zh: 元興三年三月，宗廟神主在尋陽，已立新主于太廟，權告義事。

translations.literal: Yuanxing year three third month, Grand Temple spirit tablets at Xunyang— already established new tablets at Grand Temple, provisional announcement of righteous affair.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of Yuanxing 3, Grand Temple spirit tablets were at Xunyang—new tablets had already been established at the Grand Temple, with provisional announcement of the righteous affair.

sentences.zh: 四月，輔國將軍何無忌奉送神主還。

translations.literal: Fourth month, Assistant General He Wuji escorted sending spirit tablets back.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, Assistant General He Wuji escorted the spirit tablets back.

sentences.zh: 丙子，百官拜迎于石頭。

translations.literal: Bingzi, hundred officials bowing welcoming at Shitou.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day, the hundred officials bowed in welcome at Shitou.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，入廟。

translations.literal: Wuyin, entered temple.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day they entered the temple.

sentences.zh: 安帝崩，未及禘，而天祿終焉。

translations.literal: Emperor An died, not yet reaching di, and Heaven's blessing ended.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor An died before the di sacrifice could be held, and Heaven's blessing ended.

sentences.zh: 宋武帝初受晉命為宋王，建宗廟於彭城，依魏、晉故事，立一廟。

translations.literal: When Song Emperor Wu first received Jin's mandate as King of Song, he established ancestral temple at Pengcheng, following Wei and Jin precedent, establishing one temple.
translations.idiomatic: When Song Emperor Wu first received Jin's mandate as King of Song, he established an ancestral temple at Pengcheng, following Wei and Jin precedent with a single temple.

sentences.zh: 初祠高祖開封府君、曾祖武原府君、皇祖東安府君、皇考處士府君、武敬臧后，從諸侯五廟之禮也。

translations.literal: First sacrifice to High Ancestor Lord of Kaifeng, great-grandfather Lord of Wuyuan, imperial grandfather Lord of Dong'an, imperial father Commoner Lord, Empress Wu Jing Zang— following feudal lords' five-temple ritual.
translations.idiomatic: The first sacrifice honored High Ancestor Lord of Kaifeng, great-grandfather Lord of Wuyuan, imperial grandfather Lord of Dong'an, imperial father the Commoner Lord, and Empress Wu Jing Zang—following the feudal lords' five-temple ritual.

sentences.zh: 既即尊位，乃增祠七世右北平府君、六世相國掾府君為七廟。

translations.literal: Having ascended honored position, then increased sacrifice to seventh generation Right Beiping Lord and sixth generation Chancellor's Assistant Lord as seven temples.
translations.idiomatic: After ascending the throne, he added worship of the seventh-generation Right Beiping Lord and sixth-generation Chancellor's Assistant Lord, making seven temples.

sentences.zh: 永初初，追尊皇考處士為孝穆皇帝，皇妣趙氏為穆皇后。

translations.literal: Yongchu beginning, posthumously honored imperial father Commoner as Emperor Xiaomu, imperial mother Lady Zhao as Empress Mu.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Yongchu he posthumously honored his imperial father the Commoner as Emperor Xiaomu and his imperial mother Lady Zhao as Empress Mu.

sentences.zh: 三年，孝懿蕭皇后崩，又祔廟。

translations.literal: Third year, Empress Xiaoyi Xiao died, again enfeoffed at temple.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year Empress Xiaoyi Xiao died and was again enfeoffed at the temple.

sentences.zh: 高祖崩，神主升廟，猶從昭穆之序，如魏、晉之制，虛太祖之位也。

translations.literal: High Ancestor died, spirit tablet ascended temple, still following bright-reverent ordering, like Wei and Jin system— Grand Ancestor position empty.
translations.idiomatic: When the High Ancestor died, his spirit tablet ascended the temple, still following bright-reverent order like the Wei and Jin system, with the Grand Ancestor position left empty.

sentences.zh: 廟殿亦不改構，又如晉初之因魏也。

translations.literal: Temple hall also not altered in construction, again like Jin beginning following Wei.
translations.idiomatic: The temple hall was also not rebuilt, again like early Jin following Wei.

sentences.zh: 文帝元嘉初，追尊所生胡婕妤為章皇太后，立廟西晉宣太后地。

translations.literal: Emperor Wen Yuanjia beginning, posthumously honored birth-mother Lady Hu Jieyu as Empress Dowager Zhang, established temple at Western Jin Empress Dowager Xuan's site.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Yuanjia, Emperor Wen posthumously honored his birth-mother Lady Hu Jieyu as Empress Dowager Zhang and established a temple at Western Jin Empress Dowager Xuan's site.

sentences.zh: 孝武昭太后、明帝宣太后並祔章太后廟。

translations.literal: Emperor Xiaowu's Empress Dowager Zhao and Emperor Ming's Empress Dowager Xuan all enfeoffed at Empress Dowager Zhang's temple.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Xiaowu's Empress Dowager Zhao and Emperor Ming's Empress Dowager Xuan were both enfeoffed at Empress Dowager Zhang's temple.

sentences.zh: 晉元帝太興三年正月乙卯，詔曰：「吾雖上繼世祖，然於懷、愍皇帝，皆北面稱臣。

translations.literal: Emperor Yuan of Jin Taixing year three first month yimao, edict: "Though I upward succeed World Ancestor, yet toward Emperors Huai and Min all face north calling myself subject.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of Taixing 3, Emperor Yuan of Jin issued an edict: "Though I succeed the World Ancestor, toward Emperors Huai and Min I still face north and call myself subject.

sentences.zh: 今祠太廟，不親執觴酌，而令有司行事，於情禮不安。

translations.literal: Now sacrificing at Grand Temple, not personally holding goblet and pouring, yet having responsible officials conduct ritual— in feeling and ritual not at ease.
translations.idiomatic: Now at the Grand Temple sacrifice I do not personally hold the goblet and pour, but have responsible officials conduct the ritual—in feeling and ritual this is not at ease.

sentences.zh: 可依禮更處。

translations.literal: May follow ritual and reconsider."
translations.idiomatic: It should be reconsidered according to ritual."

sentences.zh: 」太常華恒議：「今聖上繼武皇帝，宜準漢世祖故事，不親執觴爵。

translations.literal: Minister of Ceremonies Hua Heng deliberated: "Now sage sovereign succeeding Emperor Wu, it is suitable to follow Han World Ancestor precedent, not personally holding goblet and cup."
translations.idiomatic: Minister of Ceremonies Hua Heng deliberated: "Now the sage sovereign succeeds Emperor Wu; it is suitable to follow Han World Ancestor precedent and not personally hold goblet and cup."

sentences.zh: 」又曰：「今上承繼武帝，而廟之昭穆，四世而已。

translations.literal: Also said: "Now Your Majesty succeeding Emperor Wu, yet temple's bright-reverent— only four generations.
translations.idiomatic: He also said: "Your Majesty succeeds Emperor Wu, yet the temple's bright-reverent order covers only four generations.

sentences.zh: 前太常賀循、博士傅純以為惠、懷及愍宜別立廟。

translations.literal: Former Minister of Ceremonies He Xun, Erudite Fu Chun considered Emperors Hui, Huai, and Min should separately establish temples.
translations.idiomatic: Former Minister of Ceremonies He Xun and Erudite Fu Chun held that Emperors Hui, Huai, and Min should have separate temples.

sentences.zh: 然臣愚謂廟室當以容主為限，無拘常數。

translations.literal: Yet your subject considers temple chambers should take containing tablets as limit, not bound by constant number.
translations.idiomatic: Yet I consider temple chambers should be limited by capacity for tablets, not bound by a fixed number.

sentences.zh: 殷世有二祖三宗，若拘七室，則當祭禰而已。

translations.literal: Yin age had two ancestors three temples; if bound to seven chambers, then only sacrifice to father temple.
translations.idiomatic: The Yin age had two ancestors and three temples; if bound to seven chambers, one would sacrifice only to the father temple.

sentences.zh: 推此論之，宜還復豫章、潁川，全祠七廟之禮。

translations.literal: Extending this discussion, it is suitable to return Yuzhang and Yingchuan, fully worshipping seven temples' ritual.
translations.idiomatic: Extending this discussion, Yuzhang and Yingchuan should be restored and the full seven-temple ritual observed.

sentences.zh: 」驃騎長史溫嶠議：「凡言兄弟不相入廟，既非禮文。

translations.literal: Pillar-and-Cavalry Chief Clerk Wen Jiao deliberated: "Whenever saying brothers do not enter temple together— it is not ritual text.
translations.idiomatic: Pillar-and-Cavalry Chief Clerk Wen Jiao deliberated: "The claim that brothers do not enter the temple together is not found in ritual texts.

sentences.zh: 且光武奮劍振起，不策名於孝平，務神其事，以應九世之讖，又古不共廟，故別立焉。

translations.literal: Moreover Guangwu roused sword and rose, not enrolled in name under Emperor Xiaoping, devoted spirit to the affair, to respond to nine generations' prophecy; moreover ancient times did not share temples— thus separately established.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover Guangwu roused his sword and rose, was not enrolled under Emperor Xiaoping, devoted spirit to the affair to respond to the nine-generations prophecy; and ancient times did not share temples—thus he separately established one.

sentences.zh: 今上以策名而言，殊於光武之事，躬奉烝嘗，於經既正，於情又安矣。

translations.literal: Now Your Majesty by enrolled name speaking, differs from Guangwu's affair; personally performing winter and autumn sacrifices— in canon already correct, in feeling also at ease.
translations.idiomatic: Your Majesty, speaking by enrolled name, differs from Guangwu's case; personally performing winter and autumn sacrifices is canonically correct and emotionally fitting.

sentences.zh: 太常恒欲還二府君以全七世，嶠謂是宜。

translations.literal: Minister of Ceremonies Heng wished to return two lords to complete seven generations— Jiao considers this suitable.
translations.idiomatic: Minister of Ceremonies Heng wished to return the two lords to complete seven generations—Jiao considers this suitable.

sentences.zh: 」驃騎將軍王導從嶠議。

translations.literal: Pillar-and-Cavalry General Wang Dao followed Jiao's deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: Pillar-and-Cavalry General Wang Dao endorsed Jiao's view.

sentences.zh: 嶠又曰：「其非子者，可直言皇帝敢告某皇帝。

translations.literal: Jiao again said: "Those not his sons— may directly say 'The emperor dares announce to a certain emperor.'
translations.idiomatic: Jiao again said: "For those who were not his sons, one may directly say, 'The emperor dares announce to a certain emperor.'

sentences.zh: 又若以一帝為一世，則不祭禰，反不及庶人。

translations.literal: Moreover if taking one emperor as one generation, then not sacrificing to father temple— falling below even commoners.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover if one emperor counts as one generation, then not sacrificing to the father temple falls below even commoners.

sentences.zh: 」於是帝從嶠議，悉施用之。

translations.literal: Thereupon the emperor followed Jiao's deliberation, all implemented.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon the emperor followed Jiao's deliberation and implemented it all.

sentences.zh: 孫盛晉春秋曰：「陽秋傳云，『臣子一例也』。

translations.literal: Sun Sheng's Jin Spring and Autumn says: "Yangqiu Commentary says, 'Ministers and sons are one pattern.'
translations.idiomatic: Sun Sheng's Jin Spring and Autumn says: "The Yangqiu Commentary says, 'Ministers and sons follow one pattern.'

sentences.zh: 雖繼君位，不以後尊，降廢前敬。

translations.literal: Though succeeding ruler's position, not using later honor to reduce former reverence.
translations.idiomatic: Though succeeding to the ruler's position, one does not use later honor to reduce former reverence.

sentences.zh: 昔魯僖上嗣莊公，以友于長幼而升之，為逆。

translations.literal: Formerly Duke Xi of Lu upward succeeded Duke Zhuang, elevating by friendship of elder and younger— was rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: Formerly Duke Xi of Lu succeeded Duke Zhuang upward, elevating by friendship of elder and younger—that was rebellion.

sentences.zh: 準之古義，明詔是也。」

translations.literal: Measuring by ancient meaning, the bright edict is correct."
translations.idiomatic: Measured by ancient meaning, the bright edict is correct."

sentences.zh: 穆帝永和二年七月，有司奏：「十月殷祭，京兆府君當遷祧室。

translations.literal: Emperor Mu Yonghe year two seventh month, responsible officials memorialized: "Tenth month yin sacrifice, Jingzhao Lord should move to zhao chamber.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of Yonghe 2, responsible officials memorialized: "At the tenth month yin sacrifice, Jingzhao Lord should move to the zhao chamber.

sentences.zh: 昔征西、豫章、潁川三府君毀主，中興之初，權居天府，在廟門之西。

translations.literal: Formerly Campaigning West, Yuzhang, and Yingchuan three lords' destroyed tablets— at Restoration beginning, provisionally occupied Heavenly Mansion, west of temple gate.
translations.idiomatic: Formerly the destroyed tablets of Campaigning West, Yuzhang, and Yingchuan three lords—at the Restoration beginning provisionally occupied the Heavenly Mansion west of the temple gate.

sentences.zh: 咸康中，太常馮懷表續奉還於西儲夾室，謂之為祧，疑亦非禮。

translations.literal: In Xiankang, Minister of Ceremonies Feng Huai memorialized continuing to return them to western store side chambers, calling it zhao— doubt also not ritual.
translations.idiomatic: In Xiankang, Minister of Ceremonies Feng Huai memorialized continuing to return them to western store side chambers, calling it zhao—this too was doubtfully unritual.

sentences.zh: 今京兆遷入，是為四世遠祖，長在太祖之上。

translations.literal: Now Jingzhao moving in— this is four generations' distant ancestor, long above Grand Ancestor.
translations.idiomatic: Now Jingzhao moving in—this is a four-generations-distant ancestor, long above the Grand Ancestor.

sentences.zh: 昔周室太祖世遠，故遷有所歸。

translations.literal: Formerly Zhou house Grand Ancestor generations distant— thus moving had destination.
translations.idiomatic: Formerly the Zhou house's Grand Ancestor was generations distant—thus moving had a destination.

sentences.zh: 今晉廟宣皇為主，而四祖居之，是屈祖就孫也。

translations.literal: Now Jin temple Emperor Xuan as chief, yet four ancestors occupy it— this is bending ancestor to submit to grandson.
translations.idiomatic: Now in the Jin temple Emperor Xuan is chief, yet four ancestors occupy it—this is bending the ancestor to submit to the grandson.

sentences.zh: 殷祫在上，是代太祖也。

translations.literal: Yin he sacrifice above— this replaces Grand Ancestor.
translations.idiomatic: Yin he sacrifice above—this replaces the Grand Ancestor.

sentences.zh: 」領司徒蔡謨議：「四府君宜改築別室，若未展者，當入就太廟之室。

translations.literal: Acting Director of the Masters of Writing Cai Mo deliberated: "Four lords should alter construction of separate chambers; if not yet displayed, should enter and occupy Grand Temple's chambers.
translations.idiomatic: Acting Director of the Masters of Writing Cai Mo deliberated: "The four lords should have separate chambers built; if not yet displayed, they should enter Grand Temple chambers.

sentences.zh: 人莫敢卑其祖，文、武不先不窋。

translations.literal: People none dare belittle their ancestors— Wen and Wu do not precede Buqiu.
translations.idiomatic: No one dares belittle their ancestors—Wen and Wu do not precede Buqiu.

sentences.zh: 殷祭之日，征西東面，處宣皇之上。

translations.literal: On yin sacrifice day, Campaigning West faces east, positioned above Emperor Xuan.
translations.idiomatic: On yin sacrifice day, Campaigning West faces east, above Emperor Xuan.

sentences.zh: 其後遷廟之主，藏於征西之祧，祭薦不絕。

translations.literal: Thereafter moved temple's lords, stored in Campaigning West's zhao, sacrifice and offering not severed.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter moved temple lords are stored in Campaigning West's zhao, sacrifice and offering not severed.

sentences.zh: 」護軍將軍馮懷表議：「禮，『無廟者，為壇以祭』。

translations.literal: Protecting Army General Feng Huai memorialized deliberation: "Ritual: 'Those without temple— make altar to sacrifice.'
translations.idiomatic: Protecting Army General Feng Huai memorialized: "Ritual states: 'Those without a temple—make an altar to sacrifice.'

sentences.zh: 可別立室藏之，至殷禘，則祭于壇也。

translations.literal: May separately establish chamber to store them; at yin di, then sacrifice at altar."
translations.idiomatic: May separately establish a chamber to store them; at yin di, then sacrifice at the altar."

sentences.zh: 」輔國將軍譙王司馬無忌等議：「諸儒謂太王王季遷主藏於文、武之祧，如此，府君遷主，宜在宣皇帝廟中。

translations.literal: Assistant General Prince of Qiao Sima Wuji and others deliberated: "Various scholars say Great King and King Ji moved tablets stored in Wen and Wu's zhao— thus lords' moved tablets should be in Emperor Xuan's temple.
translations.idiomatic: Assistant General Prince of Qiao Sima Wuji and others deliberated: "Scholars say Great King and King Ji moved tablets stored in Wen and Wu's zhao—thus the lords' moved tablets should be in Emperor Xuan's temple.

sentences.zh: 然今無寢室，宜變通而改築。

translations.literal: Yet now no sleeping chamber— should adapt and alter construction.
translations.idiomatic: Yet now there is no sleeping chamber—construction should be adapted.

sentences.zh: 又殷祫太廟，征西東面。

translations.literal: Moreover yin he Grand Temple, Campaigning West faces east."
translations.idiomatic: Moreover at yin he in the Grand Temple, Campaigning West faces east."

sentences.zh: 」尚書郎孫綽與無忌議同。

translations.literal: Masters of Writing Gentleman Sun Chuo agreed with Wuji's deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: Masters of Writing Gentleman Sun Chuo agreed with Wuji.

sentences.zh: 曰：「太祖雖位始九五，而道以從暢，替人爵之尊，篤天倫之道，所以成教本而光百代也。

translations.literal: Said: "Grand Ancestor though position began at ninety-five, yet the Way followed from smoothness, replacing human rank's honor, deepening Heaven's kinship's Way— thus completing teaching's root and illuminating a hundred generations."
translations.idiomatic: He said: "Though the Grand Ancestor's position began at ninety-five, the Way followed from smoothness, replacing human rank's honor and deepening Heaven's kinship's Way—thus completing teaching's root and illuminating a hundred generations."

sentences.zh: 」尚書郎徐禪議：「禮，『去祧為壇，去壇為墠，歲祫則祭之』。

translations.literal: Masters of Writing Gentleman Xu Chan deliberated: "Ritual: 'Removing zhao makes altar, removing altar makes open ground; yearly he then sacrifices.'
translations.idiomatic: Masters of Writing Gentleman Xu Chan deliberated: "Ritual states: 'Removing zhao makes altar, removing altar makes open ground; yearly he then sacrifices.'

sentences.zh: 今四祖遷主，可藏之石室。

translations.literal: Now four ancestors' moved tablets may be stored in stone chamber.
translations.idiomatic: Now the four ancestors' moved tablets may be stored in a stone chamber.

sentences.zh: 有禱則祭於壇墠。

translations.literal: When there is prayer, then sacrifice at altar and open ground."
translations.idiomatic: When there is prayer, sacrifice at the altar and open ground."

sentences.zh: 」又遣禪至會稽訪處士虞喜。

translations.literal: Also sent Chan to Kuaiji to visit Recluse Yu Xi.
translations.idiomatic: They also sent Chan to Kuaiji to visit Recluse Yu Xi.

sentences.zh: 喜答曰：「漢世韋玄成等以毀主瘞於園。

translations.literal: Xi replied: "Han age Wei Xuancheng and others buried destroyed tablets in garden.
translations.idiomatic: Xi replied: "In Han times Wei Xuancheng and others buried destroyed tablets in the garden.

sentences.zh: 魏朝議者云應埋兩階之間。

translations.literal: Wei court deliberators said they should be buried between two steps.
translations.idiomatic: Wei court deliberators said they should be buried between the two steps.

sentences.zh: 且神主本在太廟，若今別室而祭，則不如永藏。

translations.literal: Moreover spirit tablets originally in Grand Temple— if now separate chamber to sacrifice, then not as good as permanent storage.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover spirit tablets originally stood in the Grand Temple—if now sacrificed in a separate chamber, permanent storage is better.

sentences.zh: 又四君無追號之禮，益明應毀而無祭。

translations.literal: Moreover four lords have no posthumous title ritual— further clarifying they should be destroyed without sacrifice."
translations.idiomatic: Moreover the four lords have no posthumous title ritual—further clarifying they should be destroyed without sacrifice."

sentences.zh: 」於是撫軍將軍會稽王司馬昱、尚書劉劭等奏：「四祖同居西祧，藏主石室，禘祫乃祭，如先朝舊儀。

translations.literal: Thereupon General of the Forward Army Prince of Kuaiji Sima Yu, Master of Writing Liu Shao and others memorialized: "Four ancestors together occupy western zhao, store tablets in stone chamber, di and he then sacrifice, like former court old ritual."
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon General of the Forward Army Prince of Kuaiji Sima Yu, Master of Writing Liu Shao, and others memorialized: "Four ancestors together occupy western zhao, store tablets in stone chamber, di and he then sacrifice, like former court old ritual."

sentences.zh: 」時陳留范宣兄子問此禮。

translations.literal: At that time Chenliu Fan Xuan's elder brother's son asked this ritual.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Chenliu Fan Xuan's elder brother's son asked about this ritual.

sentences.zh: 宣答曰：「舜廟所祭，皆是庶人。

translations.literal: Xuan replied: "Shun's temple sacrifices all are commoners.
translations.idiomatic: Xuan replied: "Shun's temple sacrifices all were commoners.

sentences.zh: 其後世遠而毀，不居舜上，不序昭穆。

translations.literal: Their later generations distant and destroyed, not occupying above Shun, not ordering bright-reverent.
translations.idiomatic: Their later generations grew distant and were destroyed, not occupying above Shun, not ordering bright-reverent.

sentences.zh: 今四君號猶依本，非以功德致禮也。

translations.literal: Now four lords' titles still follow originals— not by merit and virtue attaining ritual.
translations.idiomatic: Now the four lords' titles still follow originals—not by merit and virtue attaining ritual.

sentences.zh: 若依虞主之瘞，則猶藏子孫之所；

translations.literal: If following Yu lord's burial, then still stored where descendants are;
translations.idiomatic: If following Yu lord's burial, the tablets would remain stored where descendants are;

sentences.zh: 若依夏主之埋，則又非本廟之階。

translations.literal: if following Xia lord's burial, then again not original temple's steps.
translations.idiomatic: if following Xia lord's burial, then again not the original temple's steps.

sentences.zh: 宜思其變，別築一室，親未盡則禘祫，處宣帝之上；

translations.literal: It is suitable to think of the change, separately build one chamber; affection not exhausted then di and he, positioned above Emperor Xuan;
translations.idiomatic: It is suitable to think of the change and separately build one chamber; if affection is not exhausted then di and he, positioned above Emperor Xuan;

sentences.zh: 親盡則無緣下就子孫之列。

translations.literal: affection exhausted then no reason to descend and join descendants' ranks."
translations.idiomatic: if affection is exhausted then no reason to descend and join descendants' ranks."

sentences.zh: 」其後太常劉遐等同蔡謨議。

translations.literal: Thereafter Minister of Ceremonies Liu Xia and others agreed with Cai Mo's deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter Minister of Ceremonies Liu Xia and others agreed with Cai Mo.

sentences.zh: 博士張憑議：「或疑陳於太祖者，皆其後毀之主。

translations.literal: Erudite Zhang Ping deliberated: "Some doubt those displayed before Grand Ancestor are all their later destroyed lords.
translations.idiomatic: Erudite Zhang Ping deliberated: "Some doubt those displayed before the Grand Ancestor are all their later destroyed lords.

sentences.zh: 憑案古義無別前後之文也。

translations.literal: Ping examining ancient meaning— no separate before-after text.
translations.idiomatic: Examining ancient meaning, there is no separate before-after text.

sentences.zh: 禹不先鯀，則遷主居太祖之上，亦可無疑矣。」

translations.literal: Yu did not precede Gun— then moved lords occupying above Grand Ancestor, also can be without doubt."
translations.idiomatic: Yu did not precede Gun—then moved lords occupying above the Grand Ancestor can also be without doubt."

sentences.zh: 安帝義熙九年四月，將殷祭。

translations.literal: Emperor An Yixi year nine fourth month, about to perform yin sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of Yixi 9 under Emperor An, they were about to perform yin sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 詔博議遷毀之禮。

translations.literal: Edicted broad deliberation on moving and destroying ritual.
translations.idiomatic: An edict called for broad deliberation on moving and destroying ritual.

sentences.zh: 大司馬琅邪王司馬德文議：「泰始之初，虛太祖之位，而緣情流遠，上及征西，故世盡則宜毀，而宣皇帝正太祖之位。

translations.literal: Grand Marshal Prince of Langye Sima Dewen deliberated: "Taishi beginning, Grand Ancestor position empty, yet following affection flowing distant, upward reaching Campaigning West— thus generation exhausted then suitable to destroy, while Emperor Xuan corrects Grand Ancestor's position.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Marshal Prince of Langye Sima Dewen deliberated: "At Taishi beginning the Grand Ancestor position was empty, yet following affection flowing distant, upward reaching Campaigning West—thus when generation is exhausted it is suitable to destroy, while Emperor Xuan corrects the Grand Ancestor's position.

sentences.zh: 又漢光武帝移十一帝主於洛邑，則毀主不設，理可推矣。

translations.literal: Moreover Han Emperor Guangwu moved eleven emperors' tablets to Luoyang— then destroyed tablets not established, principle can be extended.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover Han Emperor Guangwu moved eleven emperors' tablets to Luoyang—then destroyed tablets not established, principle can be extended.

sentences.zh: 宜從范宣之言，築別室以居四府君之主，永藏而不祀也。

translations.literal: It is suitable to follow Fan Xuan's words, build separate chamber to house four lords' tablets, permanently stored without sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: They should follow Fan Xuan's advice, build a separate chamber for the four lords' tablets, and store them permanently without sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 至於諒闇奪服，慮政事之荒廢，是以乘權通以設變，量輕重而降屈。

translations.literal: As for mourning darkness seizing garments, fearing government affairs' waste and abandonment— thus riding authority to pass and establish change, measuring light and heavy and lowering and bending.
translations.idiomatic: As for mourning darkness and seizing garments, fearing the waste and abandonment of government affairs—thus riding authority to pass and establish change, measuring light and heavy and lowering and bending.

sentences.zh: 若夫奏音之與寢聲，非有損益於機務，縱復回疑於兩端，固宜緣恩而從戚矣。

translations.literal: If concerning performing sound and mourning silence— not having loss or gain to critical affairs; even again turning doubt at two ends,固宜 follow affection and follow kin.
translations.idiomatic: As for performing music and mourning silence, these neither add nor subtract from critical affairs; even if doubt turns both ways, one should still follow kinship through affection.

sentences.zh: 宋世國有故，廟祠皆懸而不樂。

translations.literal: Song age state has cause, temple sacrifice all suspended yet not music.
translations.idiomatic: In the Song age, when the state had cause, temple sacrifices all suspended music.
